zh: 连按两下 Esc，可以回到之前的任意一条消息，改一改再重来。
en: Press Esc twice to jump back to any earlier message, edit it, and try again.

zh: Shift+Tab 在几种权限模式之间切换：默认、自动接受编辑、计划模式（只想不改）。
en: Shift+Tab cycles permission modes: default, auto-accept edits, and plan mode (think, no edits).

zh: CLAUDE.md 是项目的长期记忆，每次启动都会读。不知道怎么写？跑一下 /init 让它自己生成。
en: CLAUDE.md is the project memory, read on every start. Run /init to have Claude draft one for you.

zh: 输入框里以 ! 开头，直接跑一条 shell 命令，命令和输出都会进到对话里。
en: Start a prompt with ! to run a shell command; the command and its output land in the conversation.

zh: 输入 @ 加文件路径，把文件直接带进对话，不用让 Claude 再去找。
en: Type @ plus a file path to pull that file straight into the conversation.

zh: claude -p "问题" 是无头模式：不进交互界面，答完就退出，适合塞进脚本和 CI。
en: claude -p "question" runs headless: no UI, answers and exits. Great for scripts and CI.

zh: claude -c 接着上一次的会话聊；claude --resume 可以从历史会话里挑一个继续。
en: claude -c continues your last session; claude --resume lets you pick any past one.

zh: /compact 把前面的对话压缩成摘要腾出上下文，后面可以跟一句话告诉它重点保留什么。
en: /compact summarizes the conversation to free context. Add a note to say what to keep.

zh: 子 agent 有独立的上下文窗口。派它去翻代码，翻过的几十个文件不会塞满主对话。
en: Subagents get their own context window, so the dozens of files they read stay out of yours.

zh: Hooks 能在固定时机自动跑命令，比如每次改完文件就跑格式化，不用每次提醒 Claude。
en: Hooks run commands at fixed moments, like formatting after every edit, so you never have to ask.

zh: Skill 平时只露出简介，用得上时才读全文，所以装很多也不占上下文。
en: Skills show only their description until needed, so installing many barely costs context.

zh: MCP 是 Anthropic 在 2024 年 11 月开源的协议，让模型用统一的方式接外部工具和数据。
en: Anthropic open-sourced MCP in November 2024: one standard way for models to reach tools and data.

zh: Claude Code 最早在 2025 年 2 月和 Claude 3.7 Sonnet 一起，以研究预览的身份发布。
en: Claude Code first shipped in February 2025 as a research preview alongside Claude 3.7 Sonnet.

zh: 你正在玩的蹦一蹦就是一个 Mod：挂在 Claude Code 的事件上，自己画面板、自己算动画。
en: This game is a Mod: it hooks into Claude Code events, draws its own pane and animates itself.

zh: Ctrl+G 把正在写的 prompt 丢进你的默认编辑器里写，长需求写起来舒服多了。
en: Ctrl+G opens the prompt you're typing in your default text editor, so long prompts are easier to write.

zh: Ctrl+S 先把写了一半的输入存起来，空输入框再按一次就原样恢复。
en: Ctrl+S stashes your half-written prompt; press it again on an empty prompt to bring it back.

zh: Ctrl+B 把正在跑的命令或子 agent 挪到后台，你接着聊。tmux 里要按两下。
en: Ctrl+B moves a running command or agent to the background so you can keep chatting. In tmux, press it twice.

zh: Ctrl+O 打开完整记录视图，每次工具调用的细节都在，还标着每条回复用的哪个模型。
en: Ctrl+O opens the transcript viewer: full tool-call details, plus a timestamp and the model behind each reply.

zh: 截图直接 Ctrl+V 粘进来（iTerm2 用 Cmd+V），输入框会出现 [Image #1] 这样的标记。
en: Paste a screenshot with Ctrl+V (Cmd+V in iTerm2). It shows up as an [Image #N] chip you can refer to.

zh: Ctrl+R 反向搜索以前写过的 prompt，默认把所有项目的历史都翻一遍。
en: Ctrl+R reverse-searches your past prompts, and the inline search covers every project.

zh: Option+P（Win/Linux 用 Alt+P）切换模型，已经打了一半的输入不会丢。
en: Option+P (Alt+P on Windows/Linux) switches models without clearing what you've typed.

zh: 想换行？Ctrl+J 在任何终端都能用，不用配置；输入 \ 再回车也行。
en: Need a newline? Ctrl+J works in any terminal with no setup, and so does typing \ then Enter.

zh: 输入框是空的时候按 ?，会弹出快捷键速查面板。
en: Press ? on an empty prompt to toggle the keyboard shortcut help panel.

zh: Ctrl+W 往回删到上一个空格，一下删掉整条路径；删错了 Ctrl+Y 贴回来。
en: Ctrl+W deletes back to the last space, a whole path in one press. Ctrl+Y pastes it back.

zh: Claude 干活时照样可以打字回车，消息会排队，等手头这批工具调用结束就送进同一轮。
en: Type and hit Enter while Claude works: the message queues and joins the same turn once the current tool calls finish.

zh: 排队的消息想反悔？在输入框第一行按上箭头，就能把它们拿回来改。
en: Changed your mind about a queued message? Press Up from the first line to pull it back into the input.

zh: 按 Esc 打断 Claude，已经做完的活会保留，你直接改方向就行。
en: Esc stops Claude mid-turn but keeps the work done so far, so you can redirect right away.

zh: Ctrl+Z 把 Claude Code 挂起回到 shell，敲 fg 就回来了（仅限 Unix）。
en: Ctrl+Z suspends Claude Code to your shell; run fg to come back. Unix only.

zh: vim 党在 /config 里打开 vim 模式，还能用 vimInsertModeRemaps 把 jj 映射成 Esc。
en: Vim fans: enable vim mode in /config, and use vimInsertModeRemaps to map jj to Esc.

zh: 项目里的 .claude/settings.json 改不了你的按键映射，免得克隆个仓库就被改了键位。
en: Key remaps in a project's .claude/settings.json are ignored, so a cloned repo can't remap your keystrokes.

zh: 你用 ! 自己敲的命令不进沙箱，沙箱只管 Claude 替你跑的命令。
en: Commands you type with ! run outside the sandbox. The sandbox only applies to commands Claude runs.

zh: 刚打开会话时输入框里那条灰色示例，是根据你项目最近的 git 历史挑的。
en: The grayed-out example prompt at session start is picked from your project's recent git history.

zh: 粘贴的文字里看不见的 Unicode 字符（零宽、方向控制）会在发送前被删掉，防有人藏指令。
en: Invisible Unicode in pasted text, like zero-width or bidi characters, is stripped before sending so hidden instructions can't ride along.

zh: /btw 问个旁支问题，答案不进对话历史；Claude 正在干活时也能问，不会打断它。
en: /btw asks a side question that never enters the history. It works even while Claude is busy, without interrupting.

zh: /branch 在当前位置给对话开个分支去试别的方向，原对话还在，/resume 能回去。
en: /branch forks the conversation here to try another direction. The original stays reachable via /resume.

zh: /context 用彩色格子画出上下文被谁占了，还会给出瘦身建议。
en: /context draws your context usage as a colored grid, with tips on what's eating space.

zh: /insights 分析你本机最近的会话，生成一份 HTML 报告：常干什么、哪里容易翻车、该试哪些功能。
en: /insights builds an HTML report on your recent sessions: what you work on, where things go wrong, what to try.

zh: /security-review 把当前分支相对主分支的改动过一遍安全审查：注入、鉴权、数据泄露。
en: /security-review checks your branch's diff against the default branch for injection, auth and data-exposure risks.

zh: /statusline 不带参数运行，它会照着你 shell 提示符的样子自动配好状态栏。
en: Run /statusline with no arguments and it builds a status line modeled on your shell prompt.

zh: /add-dir 给本次会话多加一个能读写的目录，跨仓库改东西时很好用。
en: /add-dir gives this session access to another directory, handy when a change spans repos.

zh: /import 能把 Codex、Gemini CLI、Cursor 的指令文件、MCP、子 agent 等配置一键搬过来。
en: /import brings instruction files, MCP servers, subagents and skills over from Codex, Gemini CLI or Cursor.

zh: 输入 /stickers，是真的可以下单 Claude Code 贴纸。
en: /stickers really does let you order Claude Code stickers.

zh: /radio 会在浏览器里打开 Claude FM，一个低保真音乐电台，写代码时听。
en: /radio opens Claude FM, a lo-fi radio stream, in your browser. Coding music, built in.

zh: /simplify 派 4 个审查 agent 并行看你的改动：能否复用、能否简化、效率等，然后直接改好。
en: /simplify runs four review agents in parallel (reuse, simplification, efficiency and more), then applies the fixes.

zh: /batch 把大规模改动拆成 5 到 30 个独立单元，每个交给一个在独立 worktree 里的子 agent。
en: /batch splits a large change into 5 to 30 independent units, each done by a subagent in its own worktree.

zh: /team-onboarding 读你最近 30 天的用法，生成一份能直接发给新同事的上手指南。
en: /team-onboarding turns your last 30 days of usage into a setup guide a new teammate can paste in.

zh: 离开终端几分钟再回来，会看到一行自动生成的会话回顾；想随时看就用 /recap。
en: Step away and come back to a one-line session recap. Run /recap to get one on demand.

zh: /rename 给会话起个名字，之后 claude --resume 加名字就能直接接上。
en: /rename names the session; later, claude --resume <name> picks it right back up.

zh: /fewer-permission-prompts 扫描你的历史记录，把你常批准的只读命令加进允许列表。
en: /fewer-permission-prompts scans your transcripts and allowlists the read-only commands you approve most.

zh: 在 macOS 和 Linux 上默认没有 Glob、Grep 工具，Claude 直接在 Bash 里用内嵌的 bfs 和 ugrep 搜。
en: On macOS and Linux, Glob and Grep are off by default; Claude runs find and grep, backed by embedded bfs and ugrep.

zh: Bash 工具每条命令是单独的进程：export 的变量下一条就没了，cd 倒会保留。
en: Each Bash command runs in its own process: an export is gone by the next command, but cd carries over.

zh: 启动时 Claude Code 会读你的 .zshrc 或 .bashrc，你的 alias 和 shell 函数它都能直接用。
en: At startup Claude Code sources your .zshrc or .bashrc, so your aliases and shell functions work for it too.

zh: 想让环境变量在命令之间保留？启动前把 CLAUDE_ENV_FILE 指向一个 shell 脚本。
en: Want env vars to persist across Bash calls? Point CLAUDE_ENV_FILE at a shell script before launching.

zh: Bash 命令默认 2 分钟超时，Claude 可以自己要更长，默认上限 10 分钟。
en: Bash commands time out after 2 minutes by default. Claude can ask for longer, up to 10 minutes.

zh: 命令跑到超时不会被杀，而是自动挪到后台继续跑，sleep 开头的除外。
en: A command that hits its timeout isn't killed: it moves to the background and keeps going, unless it starts with sleep.

zh: 命令输出超过约 3 万字符时，Claude 只拿到开头预览和一个存盘路径，需要时再去翻。
en: Past roughly 30,000 characters of output, Claude gets a preview and a saved file path, and reads more if needed.

zh: Edit 工具是精确的字符串替换，不用正则也不模糊匹配，差一个空格就对不上。
en: The Edit tool is exact string replacement: no regex, no fuzzy matching. One stray space and it misses.

zh: WebFetch 不给原网页：先转成 Markdown，再由另一个模型按提示抽取，所以会丢细节。
en: WebFetch is lossy by design: the page becomes Markdown, then a separate model call extracts what was asked.

zh: WebFetch 不访问 localhost 和不带点的内网域名，本地服务得让 Claude 用 curl。
en: WebFetch refuses localhost and dotless intranet names. For local servers Claude uses curl instead.

zh: 一个会话最多搜 200 次 WebSearch，子 agent 的搜索也算在里面，/clear 会重新计数。
en: A session gets at most 200 WebSearch calls, subagents included. /clear resets the count.

zh: 检查点只记录 Claude 用编辑工具改的文件，Bash 里的 rm、mv 回退不了。
en: Checkpoints only track edits made with Claude's file tools. An rm or mv run through Bash can't be rewound.

zh: 回退菜单里有「从这里开始总结」：只压缩后半段，开头交代的要求原样保留。
en: The rewind menu has "Summarize from here": compress the later messages, keep your early instructions intact.

zh: 检查点和对话一起存盘，关掉终端、resume 回来照样能 /rewind。
en: Checkpoints are saved with the conversation, so /rewind still works after you resume a session.

zh: Claude Code 每轮都把整段对话重发一遍，靠提示缓存按前缀匹配，只有新增部分要重新算。
en: Every turn re-sends the whole conversation. Prompt caching matches the prefix, so only new content is processed.

zh: 会话中途切模型，缓存全部作废，下一轮又慢又贵。模型最好一开始就选好。
en: Switching models mid-session throws away the cache, so the next turn is slow and pricey. Pick a model up front.

zh: 会话中途改 CLAUDE.md 不会马上生效，要等 /clear、/compact 或重启后才读新版。
en: Editing CLAUDE.md mid-session has no effect until the next /clear, /compact or restart.

zh: 订阅用户的主对话用 1 小时的提示缓存；用 API key 的默认只有 5 分钟。
en: On a Claude subscription the main conversation gets a 1-hour prompt cache; API-key users get 5 minutes by default.

zh: API key 用户可以把 promptCacheTtl 设成 1h，喝杯咖啡回来缓存还在。
en: API-key users can set promptCacheTtl to 1h so the cache survives a coffee break.

zh: 开启快速模式的那一轮会错过缓存，因为请求头变了；之后再开开关关就不影响了。
en: Turning on fast mode misses the cache once per conversation; toggling it later keeps the cache.

zh: 中途连接或断开 MCP 服务器也可能让缓存失效，因为工具定义在提示的最前面。
en: Adding or removing an MCP server mid-session can invalidate the cache: tool definitions sit at the front of the prompt.

zh: 给 Claude 一个它自己能跑的检查（测试、构建、截图对比），它就能闭环，不用你当验收员。
en: Give Claude a check it can run, like tests, a build or a screenshot diff, and it closes the loop without you.

zh: 同一个问题纠正两次还不对，就 /clear，带着学到的东西换个更具体的 prompt 重来。
en: Corrected Claude twice on the same issue? /clear and restart with a sharper prompt that uses what you learned.

zh: 做大功能前，让 Claude 用 AskUserQuestion 反过来采访你，写成 SPEC.md，再开新会话实现。
en: Before a big feature, have Claude interview you with AskUserQuestion, write SPEC.md, then build it in a fresh session.

zh: CLAUDE.md 每一行都问问：删了它 Claude 会犯错吗？不会就删。写太长反而会被忽略。
en: For each CLAUDE.md line ask: would removing it cause mistakes? If not, cut it. Bloated files get ignored.

zh: 某条规则老被无视，就只给这一行加 IMPORTANT。每行都强调，等于哪行都没强调。
en: If one rule keeps getting skipped, add IMPORTANT to that line alone. Emphasize everything and nothing stands out.

zh: 在 CLAUDE.md 里写明压缩时必须保留什么，比如改过的文件列表和测试命令。
en: Tell CLAUDE.md what compaction must keep, like "always preserve the list of modified files and test commands".

zh: 装上 gh 命令行：Claude 用它开 PR、读评论最省上下文，也不会撞上未登录 API 的限流。
en: Install the gh CLI. It's the most context-efficient way for Claude to use GitHub, and avoids unauthenticated rate limits.

zh: 没用过的命令行工具？让 Claude 先跑一遍 --help 自己学，再拿来干活。
en: Got a CLI Claude doesn't know? Tell it to read the tool's --help first, then use it.

zh: 一个 Claude 写，另一个全新上下文的 Claude 审。新的那个不会偏袒自己刚写的代码。
en: Have one Claude write and a fresh one review. A clean context isn't biased toward code it just wrote.

zh: 最常见的坑之一是「大杂烩会话」：一个会话里聊好几件无关的事，上下文全被干扰。
en: A classic failure: the kitchen-sink session, where unrelated tasks pile into one context and muddy it.

zh: 从 v2.1.283 起，终端和 VS Code 会话默认就是 auto 模式：由一个分类器模型替你审批大部分操作。
en: Since v2.1.283, terminal and VS Code sessions start in auto mode: a classifier model reviews most actions for you.

zh: 项目的 settings.json 可以设默认权限模式，但设成 auto 或 bypassPermissions 不会生效。
en: A project's settings.json can set the default permission mode, but auto and bypassPermissions are ignored there.

zh: CLAUDE.md 只是上下文，不是硬规则。真想拦住某个操作，得用 PreToolUse hook。
en: CLAUDE.md is context, not enforcement. To truly block an action, use a PreToolUse hook.

zh: 官方建议每个 CLAUDE.md 控制在 200 行以内，越长越费上下文，遵守得也越差。
en: The docs suggest keeping each CLAUDE.md under 200 lines. Longer files cost context and get followed less.

zh: CLAUDE.md 里写 @README 就能把别的文件导入进来，导入还能套导入，最多 4 层。
en: Write @README in CLAUDE.md to import another file. Imports can nest, up to four hops deep.

zh: 只想在 CLAUDE.md 里提一下路径、不想导入？用反引号包起来，`@README` 就不会被加载。
en: Want to mention a path in CLAUDE.md without importing it? Wrap it in backticks: `@README` stays literal.

zh: 个人偏好不想提交？写进项目根目录的 CLAUDE.local.md，再把它加进 .gitignore。
en: Personal prefs you don't want committed go in CLAUDE.local.md at the project root. Add it to .gitignore.

zh: CLAUDE.md 会从当前目录一路往上找，全部拼起来；子目录里的则等 Claude 读到那里才加载。
en: CLAUDE.md files from your directory and every parent are all loaded. Ones in subdirectories load when Claude reads files there.

zh: CLAUDE.md 里的 HTML 注释 <!-- --> 会被剥掉再给 Claude，写给人看的备注不占上下文。
en: HTML comments in CLAUDE.md are stripped before Claude sees it, so maintainer notes cost no context.

zh: 规则可以拆进 .claude/rules/，加上 paths 字段后，只有读写匹配的文件时才加载。
en: Split rules into .claude/rules/. Add a paths field and a rule loads only when Claude touches matching files.

zh: 大型 monorepo 里别的团队的 CLAUDE.md 太吵？用 claudeMdExcludes 按路径跳过。
en: Other teams' CLAUDE.md files cluttering your monorepo? Skip them by path with claudeMdExcludes.

zh: 仓库里只有 AGENTS.md 没有 CLAUDE.md？Claude Code 会直接读 AGENTS.md，不用额外配置。
en: No CLAUDE.md but an AGENTS.md? Claude Code reads the AGENTS.md as project instructions, no setup needed.

zh: /doctor prompt-audit 会帮你查 CLAUDE.md、skills 里过时、互相矛盾或引用不存在文件的指令。
en: /doctor prompt-audit checks CLAUDE.md and skills for stale, contradictory or broken instructions.

zh: 自动记忆分四类：你是谁、你给的纠正、项目进展、外部资料在哪。能从代码看出来的它不记。
en: Auto memory keeps four kinds of notes: user, feedback, project and reference. Anything derivable from code is skipped.

zh: 自动记忆存在 ~/.claude/projects/<项目>/memory/，同一仓库的所有 worktree 共用一份。
en: Auto memory lives in ~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory/, shared by every worktree of the same repo.

zh: 每次会话只加载 MEMORY.md 的前 200 行或前 25KB，具体笔记放在单独文件里按需读。
en: Each session loads only the first 200 lines or 25KB of MEMORY.md. Detailed notes sit in topic files read on demand.

zh: 企业下发的托管 CLAUDE.md 个人排除不掉，保证全公司的规范都生效。
en: An org-managed CLAUDE.md can't be excluded by individual settings, so company-wide guidance always applies.

zh: 权限规则的判定顺序是 deny、ask、allow。allow 写得再细，也开不了 deny 的口子。
en: Permission rules check deny, then ask, then allow. A narrower allow rule can't carve an exception out of a deny.

zh: 选了「以后别再问」，规则会存进仓库根目录的 .claude/settings.local.json。
en: Choosing "don't ask again" saves the rule to .claude/settings.local.json at the repo root.

zh: 批准或拒绝权限请求前按 Tab，可以附一句话给 Claude，比如「可以，但别动测试」。
en: On a permission prompt, press Tab on Yes or No to attach a note, like "yes, but leave the tests alone".

zh: 直接点 No 会停下这一轮；No 加一句理由，Claude 会带着你的意见接着干。
en: Plain No stops the turn. No with a comment sends your reason to Claude, and it keeps working.

zh: Bash(ls *) 和 Bash(ls*) 不一样：带空格的不会匹配 lsof，不带空格的会。
en: Bash(ls *) and Bash(ls*) differ: with the space it won't match lsof, without it, it will.

zh: 匹配规则前会剥掉 timeout、nice、nohup 这类包装，Bash(npm test *) 也能放行 timeout 30 npm test。
en: Wrappers like timeout, nice and nohup are stripped first, so Bash(npm test *) also matches timeout 30 npm test.

zh: ls、cat 这类只读命令本来就不用批准；但超过 1 万字符的命令一律要问你。
en: Read-only commands like ls or cat run without prompts, but any command over 10,000 characters always asks.

zh: cd 到别的目录再跑 git 会弹确认：新目录里的 git hooks 可能偷偷执行代码。
en: cd into another directory then run git, and you'll be asked: that directory's git hooks could run code.

zh: 给某个文件加 Read 的 deny 规则后，Edit 和 Write 也一起被挡住，连新建都不行。
en: A Read deny rule on a path also blocks Edit and Write there, even creating a new file.

zh: deny 里只写工具名（比如 WebFetch），这个工具会从 Claude 的上下文里整个消失。
en: A deny rule with just a tool name, like WebFetch, removes that tool from Claude's context entirely.

zh: 不管什么权限模式，rm -rf / 或 rm -rf ~ 这类删根目录、家目录的命令都不会被规则自动放行。
en: In any mode, rm on critical paths like / or ~ can never be auto-approved by an allow rule or hook.

zh: auto 模式默认会拦：curl | bash、force push、git reset --hard、生产部署、外发敏感数据等。
en: Auto mode blocks by default: curl | bash, force push, git reset --hard, prod deploys, sending secrets out.

zh: 在对话里说「别 push」，auto 模式的分类器会当真并拦下。但被压缩掉就失效，硬约束请写 deny。
en: Say "don't push" and auto mode's classifier will block it, but compaction can drop that. Use a deny rule for hard limits.

zh: 在 auto 模式里光说「可以 force push」不够，要说清推哪个分支，分类器才放行。
en: In auto mode, "you can force-push" isn't enough. Name the branch and the classifier will allow it.

zh: auto 模式连续拦 3 次或累计拦 20 次，就会暂停，改回逐个问你。
en: If auto mode blocks 3 actions in a row or 20 in total, it pauses and goes back to asking you.

zh: dontAsk 模式：凡是要问你的操作一律拒绝，只跑预先允许的，适合 CI。
en: dontAsk mode auto-denies anything that would prompt and runs only pre-approved tools. Good for CI.

zh: 企业可以设 disableBypassPermissionsMode，彻底禁掉 --dangerously-skip-permissions。
en: Admins can set disableBypassPermissionsMode to rule out --dangerously-skip-permissions entirely.

zh: 计划模式里 Claude 只读、只探索、只写方案，不改你的源码，批准后才开工。
en: In plan mode Claude reads, explores and writes a plan but won't edit your source until you approve.

zh: 不用按 Shift+Tab 切模式：输入 /plan 加任务描述，直接进计划模式开干，比如 /plan 修登录 bug。
en: Skip the Shift+Tab cycling: /plan plus a task enters plan mode and starts on it, like /plan fix the auth bug.

zh: 方案出来后按 Ctrl+G，可以直接在编辑器里改方案，再让 Claude 照着做。
en: When the plan is ready, press Ctrl+G to edit it in your text editor before Claude proceeds.

zh: 沙箱在 macOS 上用系统自带的 Seatbelt，在 Linux 和 WSL2 上用 bubblewrap；原生 Windows 不支持。
en: The sandbox uses Seatbelt on macOS and bubblewrap on Linux and WSL2. Native Windows runs unsandboxed.

zh: 沙箱只管 shell 命令。Read、Edit 这些文件工具、MCP 服务器和 hooks 都在沙箱外，靠权限规则管。
en: The sandbox only wraps shell commands. File tools, MCP servers and hooks run outside it, governed by permissions.

zh: 沙箱的底层是开源的 @anthropic-ai/sandbox-runtime，你自己的项目也能拿来用。
en: The sandbox is built on the open-source @anthropic-ai/sandbox-runtime package, usable in your own projects.

zh: 沙箱的「自动放行」模式下，在沙箱里跑的命令不用逐个批准，deny 规则照样生效。
en: In the sandbox's auto-allow mode, sandboxed commands run without prompts. Deny rules still apply.

zh: 命令在沙箱里失败时，Claude 可以申请出沙箱重跑；设 allowUnsandboxedCommands 为 false 就关掉这个口子。
en: When a command fails in the sandbox, Claude can ask to rerun it outside. allowUnsandboxedCommands: false closes that door.

zh: hook 想拦住操作要 exit 2，exit 1 只算普通报错，操作照样执行。这是最常见的坑。
en: To block, a hook must exit 2. Exit 1 is a non-blocking error and the action still runs. A classic gotcha.

zh: 配一个 Notification hook，Claude 等你批准或回复时弹系统通知，不用一直盯着终端。
en: A Notification hook can pop a desktop alert when Claude waits for approval or input, so you can look away.

zh: SessionStart hook 加 compact 匹配器，每次压缩完自动把关键约定重新塞回上下文。
en: A SessionStart hook with the compact matcher re-injects key context after every compaction.

zh: Stop hook 可以跑你的检查脚本，没通过就不让这一轮结束，逼 Claude 修到绿为止。
en: A Stop hook can run your checks and refuse to let the turn end until they pass.

zh: hook 不止能跑 shell：还有 http、mcp_tool，以及让模型来判断的 prompt 和 agent 类型。
en: Hooks aren't just shell commands: there are http, mcp_tool, and model-judged prompt and agent types too.

zh: 同一事件的多个 hook 是并行跑的，最后取最严格的结论：deny 压过 ask，ask 压过 allow。
en: Hooks on the same event run in parallel; the strictest verdict wins, deny over ask over allow.

zh: PreToolUse hook 返回 allow 也绕不过 deny 规则，企业下发的禁用清单照样生效。
en: A PreToolUse hook returning allow still can't bypass deny rules, including managed deny lists.

zh: 用 PermissionRequest hook 精确放行 ExitPlanMode，每次方案写完就不用再点确认。
en: A PermissionRequest hook matching ExitPlanMode can auto-approve plans so you skip that prompt.

zh: 用 direnv？配上 CwdChanged hook，Claude 每次 cd 都会重新加载对应目录的环境变量。
en: Using direnv? A CwdChanged hook reloads the right env vars every time Claude changes directory.

zh: hook 往上下文里加料时，additionalContext 要放在 hookSpecificOutput 里面，放顶层会被悄悄忽略。
en: Nest additionalContext inside hookSpecificOutput in UserPromptSubmit hooks; at the top level it's silently ignored.

zh: /hooks 能看当前生效的所有 hook。也可以直接让 Claude 写：「每次改完文件跑一下 eslint」。
en: /hooks lists every active hook. Or just ask Claude: "write a hook that runs eslint after every edit."

zh: Skills 遵循 Agent Skills 开放标准（agentskills.io），同一个 skill 能在多个 AI 工具里用。
en: Skills follow the open Agent Skills standard (agentskills.io), so one skill can work across AI tools.

zh: SKILL.md 里写 !`git diff HEAD`，会先跑命令把结果填进去，Claude 读到的就是最新 diff。
en: Write !`git diff HEAD` in a SKILL.md and the command's output is inlined before Claude reads it.

zh: 有副作用的 skill（比如部署）加 disable-model-invocation: true，只有你敲命令时才会跑。
en: For skills with side effects like deploys, set disable-model-invocation: true so only you can trigger them.

zh: 反过来，user-invocable: false 的 skill 不出现在 / 菜单里，只给 Claude 当背景知识用。
en: Conversely, user-invocable: false hides a skill from the / menu and leaves it as background knowledge for Claude.

zh: skill 的 description 加 when_to_use 超过 1536 个字符会被截断，最关键的用途要写在最前面。
en: A skill's description plus when_to_use is cut off at 1,536 characters, so lead with the key use case.

zh: skill 里用 $ARGUMENTS 拿全部参数，$0、$1 拿第几个。/fix-issue 1234 就能把 1234 传进去。
en: In a skill, $ARGUMENTS holds all arguments and $0, $1 pick one. /fix-issue 1234 passes in 1234.

zh: skill 加 context: fork，就会在独立的子 agent 里跑，不弄脏主对话的上下文。
en: Add context: fork and a skill runs in its own subagent, keeping the main conversation clean.

zh: 老的 .claude/commands/*.md 自定义命令照样能用，跟 skill 重名时 skill 优先。
en: Old .claude/commands/*.md files still work. If one shares a name with a skill, the skill wins.

zh: 在 /skills 里按 t 可以按 token 占用排序，看看哪个 skill 最占上下文。
en: In /skills, press t to sort by token count and see which skills cost the most context.

zh: 内置的 /code-review 可以被你自己同名的 skill 替换，但别名 /review 还是指向内置版。
en: Your own code-review skill replaces the built-in /code-review, but the /review alias still runs the built-in.

zh: 仓库里有叫 verify 或 simplify 的 skill 时，Claude 每次 commit 前都会先跑它。
en: If a repo has a skill named verify or simplify, Claude runs it before each commit.

zh: /verify 会真的构建、启动你的应用去看改动有没有生效，而不是只看测试和类型检查。
en: /verify actually builds and runs your app to confirm a change works, rather than trusting tests or type checks.

zh: 内置的 Explore 和 Plan 子 agent 会跳过 CLAUDE.md 和 git 状态，就为了查得更快更省。
en: The built-in Explore and Plan subagents skip CLAUDE.md and git status to keep research fast and cheap.

zh: 自己定义一个叫 Explore 的子 agent 并写上 model: haiku，就能让代码探索跑在更便宜的模型上。
en: Define your own subagent named Explore with model: haiku to run code exploration on a cheaper model.

zh: 想指定某个子 agent 干活？输入 @agent-名字，比让 Claude 自己挑更稳。
en: Want a specific subagent? Type @agent-<name> to guarantee it runs instead of leaving the choice to Claude.

zh: 子 agent 就是 .claude/agents/ 下带 YAML 头的 Markdown 文件，必填的只有 name 和 description。
en: A subagent is a Markdown file with YAML frontmatter in .claude/agents/. Only name and description are required.

zh: Claude 靠 description 决定什么时候派活给子 agent。所有自定义描述加起来超过 1.5 万 token 会报警。
en: Claude delegates based on each subagent's description. Combined custom descriptions over 15,000 tokens trigger a warning.

zh: 子 agent 的 tools 列表里不写 Agent，它就没法再派生自己的子 agent。
en: Leave Agent out of a subagent's tools list and it can't spawn subagents of its own.

zh: 子 agent 加 isolation: worktree，会在临时 git worktree 里干活，不碰你的工作区。
en: Give a subagent isolation: worktree and it works in a temporary git worktree, away from your checkout.

zh: 子 agent 也能有自己的长期记忆：frontmatter 里加 memory 字段，跨会话积累经验。
en: Subagents can keep their own persistent memory: add a memory field to the frontmatter.

zh: /subtask 会派一个继承完整对话的分叉子 agent 去后台干活，你在前台接着聊。
en: /subtask spawns a forked subagent that inherits the whole conversation and works in the background while you continue.

zh: 子 agent 改的文件，/rewind 一般恢复不了，要靠 git 回退。
en: Edits made by subagents usually aren't restored by /rewind. Use git to revert them.

zh: MCP 服务器有三种作用域：local（默认，只你自己、只这个项目）、project（写进 .mcp.json 共享）、user（你所有项目）。
en: MCP servers have three scopes: local (default, just you, this project), project (shared via .mcp.json) and user (all your projects).

zh: .mcp.json 支持 ${VAR:-默认值} 写法，团队共享配置时 API key 留在各自的环境变量里。
en: .mcp.json supports ${VAR:-default}, so a team can share config while API keys stay in each person's env.

zh: 克隆来的仓库里 .mcp.json 声明的服务器，要你在交互会话里点头批准后才会连接。
en: Servers declared in a cloned repo's .mcp.json don't connect until you approve them in an interactive session.

zh: 在 Claude Desktop 里配过 MCP？claude mcp add-from-claude-desktop 一键导入。
en: Already set up MCP servers in Claude Desktop? claude mcp add-from-claude-desktop imports them.

zh: claude mcp serve 能把 Claude Code 自己变成一个 MCP 服务器，给别的应用调用。
en: claude mcp serve turns Claude Code itself into an MCP server other apps can connect to.

zh: MCP 工具默认是「延迟加载」：先不把所有工具定义塞进上下文，用到时再搜出来加载。
en: MCP tools are deferred by default: tool search loads their definitions on demand instead of upfront.

zh: MCP 工具返回超过 1 万 token 会警告，默认上限 2.5 万，可以用 MAX_MCP_OUTPUT_TOKENS 调高。
en: MCP tool output over 10,000 tokens triggers a warning; the default cap is 25,000. Raise it with MAX_MCP_OUTPUT_TOKENS.

zh: MCP 服务器提供的 prompt 会直接变成斜杠命令，输入 / 就能看到。
en: Prompts exposed by MCP servers show up as slash commands in the / menu.

zh: MCP 服务器提供的资源，可以像文件一样用 @ 引用进对话。
en: Resources from MCP servers can be pulled into the conversation with @, just like files.

zh: 一次 MCP 调用跑超过 2 分钟，会自动挪到后台，Claude 先干别的，结果回来再通知。
en: An MCP call still running after 2 minutes moves to the background; Claude keeps working and gets notified later.

zh: 你在 claude.ai 上连好的连接器（比如 Slack），用同一账号登录 Claude Code 时也能直接用。
en: Connectors you've set up on claude.ai, like Slack, are available in Claude Code when you sign in with that account.

zh: 远程 MCP 服务器要 OAuth 登录？在会话里跑 /mcp 就能完成授权。
en: Remote MCP server needs OAuth? Run /mcp in a session to authenticate.

zh: claude -p 默认会跑项目里的 hooks 和 .mcp.json，而且不弹信任确认。陌生仓库里用要当心。
en: claude -p runs a project's hooks and .mcp.json servers with no trust dialog. Be careful in unfamiliar repos.

zh: --bare 跳过 CLAUDE.md、hooks、MCP、插件的自动发现，CI 里每台机器结果一致，启动也更快。
en: --bare skips discovery of CLAUDE.md, hooks, MCP and plugins, so CI runs start faster and behave the same everywhere.

zh: --bare 模式不读你的订阅登录和钥匙串，要自己设 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY。
en: Bare mode never reads your subscription login or keychain. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY yourself.

zh: --output-format json 的结果里带 total_cost_usd，脚本可以直接记账。
en: With --output-format json, the result includes total_cost_usd, so scripts can track spend directly.

zh: 要结构化结果？--output-format json 加 --json-schema，输出会按你给的 JSON Schema 校验。
en: Need structured results? Combine --output-format json with --json-schema to get output validated against your schema.

zh: 脚本里给 claude -p 加 --max-turns 或 --max-budget-usd，防止它跑太久或花太多。
en: In scripts, cap claude -p with --max-turns or --max-budget-usd so it can't run or spend too much.

zh: 把 git diff 管道喂给 claude -p，就能在 package.json 里做一个专抓错别字的「AI lint」。
en: Pipe git diff into claude -p in a package.json script and you've got an AI linter for typos.

zh: claude setup-token 生成一个长期有效的 OAuth token，给 CI 和脚本用你的订阅。
en: claude setup-token generates a long-lived OAuth token so CI and scripts can use your subscription.

zh: Agent SDK 就是 Claude Code 背后那套工具、循环和上下文管理，有 Python 和 TypeScript 版。
en: The Agent SDK gives you the same tools, agent loop and context management that power Claude Code, in Python and TypeScript.

zh: 在仓库里跑 /install-github-app，会装好 GitHub App、存好密钥、开好 workflow PR，合并后就能 @claude。
en: Run /install-github-app: it installs the app, stores the secret and opens a workflow PR. Merge it and @claude works.

zh: 给整个组织共用的 Action 密钥最好用 Console 的 API key，OAuth token 绑的是生成它那个人的订阅。
en: For an org-wide Action secret, use a Console API key. An OAuth token is tied to whoever ran setup-token.

zh: 托管版 Code Review 会派一组 agent 并行审 PR，再有一步验证过滤误报，平均约 20 分钟审完。
en: Managed Code Review runs a fleet of agents on each PR, then verifies findings to filter false positives. About 20 minutes on average.

zh: Code Review 的检查结果永远是 neutral，不会卡住合并；想拿它当门禁，得自己在 CI 里读结果。
en: Code Review's check run always ends neutral, so it never blocks merging. Gate on it yourself in CI if you want.

zh: 在 PR 里评论 @claude review 可以手动触发一次审查。想调教它审什么，写个 REVIEW.md。
en: Comment @claude review on a PR to trigger a review. Tune what it flags with a REVIEW.md.

zh: 压缩后，项目根目录的 CLAUDE.md 会从磁盘重新读一遍；子目录的 CLAUDE.md 要等 Claude 再读到那里才回来。
en: After compaction, the root CLAUDE.md is re-read from disk. Nested ones return only when Claude reads files there again.

zh: 压缩完 Claude Code 会把最近改过的最多 5 个文件重新读进来，接着干活不断片。
en: Right after compaction, Claude Code re-reads up to five of the most recently modified files from the session.

zh: 压缩后 skill 正文会重新注入，但每个最多 5000 token，超出的截掉尾巴。重要的话写在 SKILL.md 开头。
en: After compaction, skill bodies come back capped at 5,000 tokens each, truncated from the end. Put key rules at the top.

zh: 计划模式里写好的方案，压缩之后会从磁盘重新注入，不会被总结丢掉。
en: The plan Claude wrote in plan mode is re-injected from disk after compaction, not summarized away.

zh: /autocompact 500k 可以自己定上下文用到多满再自动压缩，范围是 10 万到 100 万 token。
en: /autocompact 500k sets how full context gets before auto-compaction, anywhere from 100K to 1M tokens.

zh: 原生 100 万上下文的模型不会等到塞满才压缩，默认在约 96.7 万 token 时就动手。
en: Models with a native 1M window don't wait until it's full: auto-compaction kicks in around 967K tokens by default.

zh: 一个 hook 先 grep 出 ERROR 再给 Claude，比让它读 1 万行日志省下几万 token。
en: A hook that greps a log for ERROR before Claude sees it can shrink tens of thousands of tokens to hundreds.

zh: gh、aws、gcloud 这类命令行工具比 MCP 更省上下文，因为它们不用占一份工具清单。
en: CLIs like gh, aws and gcloud are more context-efficient than MCP servers: no per-tool listing to carry.

zh: 给 TypeScript 等强类型语言装代码智能插件，一次「跳转定义」顶得上 grep 加读一堆文件。
en: Install a code intelligence plugin for typed languages: one go-to-definition beats a grep plus several file reads.

zh: 官方数据：企业部署里平均每个开发者每个活跃日约 13 美元，90% 的人一天不到 30 美元。
en: Per Anthropic, enterprise users average about $13 per developer per active day, and 90% stay under $30.

zh: /usage 里有一行提示缓存统计：命中率多少、错过几次，一看就知道钱花在哪。
en: /usage includes a prompt cache line: hit rate, misses and whether the cache is warm, so you can see where money goes.

zh: 订阅用户的 /usage 还会拆账：多少用量花在了哪个 skill、子 agent、插件或 MCP 服务器上。
en: On subscription plans, /usage breaks down usage by skill, subagent, plugin and MCP server.

zh: 官方建议：日常写代码用 Sonnet 就够，Opus 留给复杂架构决策和多步推理。
en: The docs' advice: Sonnet handles most coding; save Opus for complex architecture and multi-step reasoning.

zh: opusplan 是个特殊模型设置：计划模式用 Opus 想，执行时切到 Sonnet 干。
en: opusplan is a special model setting: Opus thinks in plan mode, then Sonnet carries out the work.

zh: 在 prompt 里写 ultrathink，只让这一轮多想想，不改会话的 effort 设置。
en: Put ultrathink in a prompt for deeper reasoning on that turn only, without changing the session's effort level.

zh: 现在只有 ultrathink 是关键词。think hard、think more 这类说法只会当普通文字发出去。
en: Today only ultrathink is a keyword. Phrases like "think hard" are passed through as ordinary text.

zh: /model 选中某个模型后按 s，只在本会话切换，不改你的默认模型。
en: In the /model picker, press s to switch for this session only and leave your default alone.

zh: 想在不同终端同时跑不同模型？每个都用 --model 启动，别用 /model，它会改全局默认。
en: Running different models in different terminals? Launch each with --model; /model saves a new default.

zh: resume 的旧会话会沿用当时的模型，不管你现在默认设的是什么。
en: A resumed session keeps the model it was using when saved, regardless of your current default.

zh: sonnet[1m]、opus[1m] 这样带后缀的别名会启用 100 万 token 上下文。
en: Aliases with a suffix, like sonnet[1m] or opus[1m], turn on the 1-million-token context window.

zh: --fallback-model sonnet,haiku 可以设备用模型链：主模型过载时自动顶上，最多 3 个。
en: --fallback-model sonnet,haiku sets a fallback chain for when the primary model is overloaded, up to three models.

zh: /effort 调思考力度，从 low 到 max。改 effort 在多数模型上会让缓存失效。
en: /effort sets reasoning effort from low to max. On most models, changing it mid-session invalidates the cache.

zh: 快速模式不是换模型，还是同一个 Opus，只是换了更快的配置，最多快 2.5 倍，单价更高。
en: Fast mode isn't a different model: it's the same Opus with a faster config, up to 2.5x quicker at a higher price.

zh: 订阅用户的快速模式走额外的 usage credits，不占套餐里的额度。
en: On subscription plans, fast mode bills to usage credits, not your plan's included limits.

zh: /advisor 让主模型在关键节点去请教一个更强的模型，比如定方案前、卡住时、宣布完成前。
en: /advisor lets Claude consult a stronger model at key moments: before choosing an approach, when stuck, before finishing.

zh: 会话记录以 JSONL 存在 ~/.claude/projects/<项目>/ 下，默认保留 30 天，cleanupPeriodDays 可改。
en: Transcripts are JSONL files under ~/.claude/projects/<project>/, kept 30 days by default. Change it with cleanupPeriodDays.

zh: claude -p 和 Agent SDK 跑出来的会话不会出现在 /resume 列表里，但拿会话 ID 照样能接上。
en: Sessions from claude -p or the Agent SDK stay out of the /resume picker, but you can still resume them by ID.

zh: /resume 选择器里按 Ctrl+W 看同仓库所有 worktree 的会话，按 Ctrl+A 看本机所有项目。
en: In the /resume picker, Ctrl+W widens to all worktrees of the repo and Ctrl+A to every project on the machine.

zh: claude --resume abc --fork-session 会复制出一个新会话接着聊，原会话保持不动。
en: claude --resume <id> --fork-session continues in a new session ID, leaving the original untouched.

zh: Pro/Max 用户恢复一个闲置超 1 小时、超 10 万 token 的会话时，会问你要不要先压缩成摘要再继续，省钱。
en: On Pro/Max, resuming a big session idle for over an hour offers to continue from a summary to save tokens.

zh: claude -w 功能名 会在 .claude/worktrees/ 下开一个独立 worktree 和分支再启动，多开互不干扰。
en: claude -w <name> starts Claude in its own worktree and branch under .claude/worktrees/, so parallel sessions don't collide.

zh: worktree 是全新检出，没有 .env。在项目根目录放个 .worktreeinclude，新建时自动拷过去。
en: A worktree is a fresh checkout without your .env. List files in .worktreeinclude to copy them in automatically.

zh: 退出 worktree 会话时，如果里面没改动就自动删掉；有改动会问你留还是删。
en: When you exit a worktree session, a clean worktree is removed automatically; one with changes prompts you first.

zh: claude -w 后面直接跟 PR 链接或 #编号，会从那个 PR 拉分支开 worktree。
en: Pass a PR URL or #number to claude -w and it branches the new worktree from that pull request.

zh: Claude 开过的 PR 会自动关联到会话，之后 claude --from-pr 123 就能找回当时的对话。
en: Sessions are linked to PRs Claude creates, so claude --from-pr 123 finds the conversation behind a PR.

zh: 不想要提交里的 Co-Authored-By 署名？在设置里把 attribution 配成你想要的，或者直接关掉。
en: Don't want the Co-Authored-By trailer? Customize or turn it off with the attribution setting.

zh: /autofix-pr 会开一个云端会话盯着当前分支的 PR，CI 挂了或有人评论就自动推修复。
en: /autofix-pr starts a cloud session that watches your branch's PR and pushes fixes when CI fails or reviewers comment.

zh: /diff 在会话里直接看工作区改动，既有 Claude 改的，也有你自己没提交的。
en: /diff shows working-tree changes in-session: Claude's edits plus anything else you haven't committed.

zh: 设置优先级从高到低：企业托管、命令行参数、本地项目、共享项目、用户级。
en: Settings precedence, highest first: managed, command line, local project, shared project, user.

zh: 权限这类列表型设置不是覆盖而是合并，几层的规则会叠在一起生效。
en: List settings like permission rules merge across levels instead of overriding each other.

zh: settings.json 顶部加上 $schema 指向 schemastore，编辑器里就有自动补全和校验。
en: Add a $schema line pointing at schemastore to settings.json and your editor autocompletes and validates it.

zh: 想让 Claude 默认用中文回复？在设置里加 "language": "chinese" 就行。
en: Want Claude to reply in another language by default? Set "language", e.g. "japanese", in settings.

zh: 干活时转圈的动词也能换：spinnerVerbs 可以追加或者替换成你自己的词。
en: You can change the spinner's rotating verbs too: spinnerVerbs appends to or replaces the built-in list.

zh: 怕新版有 bug？把 autoUpdatesChannel 设成 stable，跟的是大约一周前、没大问题的版本。
en: Wary of fresh releases? Set autoUpdatesChannel to stable for a build about a week old, minus major regressions.

zh: 计划模式写的方案默认存在 ~/.claude/plans，用 plansDirectory 可以改到项目里方便提交。
en: Plan-mode plans are saved in ~/.claude/plans by default; plansDirectory moves them into your project.

zh: VS Code 里选中代码 Claude 自动就能看到；按 Option+K（Win 用 Alt+K）插入带行号的 @文件引用。
en: In VS Code Claude sees your selection automatically. Option+K (Alt+K) inserts an @file#lines reference.

zh: 在 VS Code 里按 Cmd+Esc（Win 用 Ctrl+Esc）在编辑器和 Claude 输入框之间来回切焦点。
en: In VS Code, Cmd+Esc (Ctrl+Esc) toggles focus between the editor and Claude's prompt box.

zh: 连上 IDE 后，Claude 能直接读到编辑器 Problems 面板里的报错和警告。
en: Connected to your IDE, Claude can read the errors and warnings from the editor's Problems panel.

zh: JetBrains 插件不自带 CLI，它是在 IDE 的终端里跑 claude 再连上去，所以两样都要装。
en: The JetBrains plugin doesn't bundle the CLI: it runs claude in the IDE terminal and connects, so install both.

zh: 在 JetBrains 里，Claude 的改动会直接在 IDE 的 diff 查看器里打开，不在终端里看。
en: In JetBrains IDEs, Claude's changes open in the IDE's diff viewer instead of the terminal.

zh: 装上 Claude in Chrome 扩展后，Claude 能在你已登录的浏览器里读控制台、点页面、测表单。
en: With the Claude in Chrome extension, Claude can read console errors, click through pages and test forms in your logged-in browser.

zh: 终端里输入 /desktop，会话会原样搬到桌面端 App 里继续（macOS 和 x64 Windows）。
en: Run /desktop in the terminal to move the session into the desktop app (macOS and x64 Windows).

zh: 桌面端和 CLI 用的是同一个引擎，可以在同一个项目里同时开，各管各的会话列表。
en: Desktop runs the same engine as the CLI. You can use both at once, even on the same project.

zh: 桌面端里 Claude 能自己起开发服务器，在内置浏览器里截图验证改动，这个自动验证默认开着。
en: In Desktop, Claude can start your dev server and verify changes in the built-in browser. Auto-verify is on by default.

zh: 桌面端可以通过 SSH 连到远程机器跑 Claude Code，代码在云主机或开发容器里也能用。
en: Desktop can run Claude Code on a remote machine over SSH, handy for code on cloud VMs or dev containers.

zh: 在 claude.ai/code 跑的云端会话里，你的 GitHub 凭证从不进虚拟机，Git 操作走代理加签。
en: In cloud sessions your GitHub credentials never enter the VM; git traffic goes through a proxy that adds them.

zh: 终端里 claude --cloud "任务" 直接开一个云端会话；/teleport 再把云端会话拉回本地终端。
en: claude --cloud "task" starts a cloud session from your terminal; /teleport pulls a cloud session back down.

zh: 云端会话关了电脑也照样跑，手机 Claude App 的 Code 页签就能开和盯。
en: Cloud sessions keep running with your laptop closed, and you can start and watch them from the Code tab in the Claude app.

zh: Remote Control：claude remote-control 让手机或网页遥控你电脑上的会话，代码和文件都留在本机。
en: Remote Control lets your phone or browser drive a session on your own machine; code and files stay local.

zh: 开着 Remote Control 时，跟 Claude 说一句「测试跑完通知我」，它就会推送到你手机上。
en: With Remote Control on, tell Claude "notify me when the tests finish" and it pushes to your phone.

zh: Claude 不听 CLAUDE.md？先跑 /context 看文件到底有没有加载，再去琢磨写法。
en: Claude ignoring CLAUDE.md? Run /context first to check the file actually loaded, then look at the wording.

zh: claude doctor 不进会话，直接打印安装和设置文件的诊断；会话里的 /doctor 还能帮你修。
en: claude doctor prints install and settings diagnostics without a session; /doctor in a session can also fix things.

zh: MCP 服务器起不来？常见原因是相对路径：它按你启动 Claude 的目录解析，不是按 .mcp.json 所在位置。
en: MCP server won't start? Relative paths resolve from where you launched Claude, not from the .mcp.json file.

zh: hook 不触发？多半是 matcher 里工具名拼错了，它会悄无声息地什么都不匹配。
en: Hook not firing? Usually a misspelled tool name in the matcher, which silently matches nothing.

zh: 改了 settings.json 不用重启，正在跑的会话过一会儿就会生效。
en: Edits to settings.json apply to the running session after a short delay. No restart needed.

zh: 怀疑是自己的配置惹的祸？claude --safe-mode 关掉 CLAUDE.md、插件、hooks、MCP 等所有自定义再试。
en: Suspect your own config? claude --safe-mode disables CLAUDE.md, plugins, hooks, MCP and other customizations.

zh: 会话中途想开调试日志？跑 /debug，它会打开日志并帮你读日志排查。
en: Need debug logs mid-session? /debug turns logging on and reads the log to troubleshoot.

zh: claude purge 能清掉某个项目在本机的全部记录：会话、任务、调试日志、编辑历史。
en: claude purge wipes a project's local Claude Code state: transcripts, tasks, debug logs and edit history.

zh: 插件就是把 skills、子 agent、hooks、MCP 服务器打成一个包，一条命令装好给团队用。
en: A plugin bundles skills, subagents, hooks and MCP servers into one unit you can install with one command.

zh: 插件市场其实就是一个带 .claude-plugin/marketplace.json 的仓库，是目录不是商店。
en: A plugin marketplace is just a repo with a .claude-plugin/marketplace.json file: a catalog, not a hosted store.

zh: 启用的插件每轮都在上下文里占位置（skill 名字和描述），不用的记得关掉。
en: An enabled plugin costs context every turn, since its skill names and descriptions are always listed. Disable unused ones.

zh: 插件的 skill 自动带命名空间，比如 /my-plugin:deploy，不会和你自己的同名 skill 打架。
en: Plugin skills are namespaced, like /my-plugin:deploy, so they never clash with your own skills.

zh: 开发插件时用 claude --plugin-dir ./my-plugin 临时加载，只对这次会话生效。
en: Developing a plugin? claude --plugin-dir ./my-plugin loads it for that session only.

zh: 第一次启动交互会话时，Claude Code 会自动加上 Anthropic 官方插件市场。
en: Claude Code adds Anthropic's official plugin marketplace the first time you start an interactive session.

zh: Mod 是用 JS/TS 写的插件，跑在 Claude Code 内部，能画面板、改界面、拦工具调用。需要 v2.1.287+。
en: A mod is a JS/TS plugin that runs inside Claude Code: it can draw panes, restyle the UI, and step into tool calls. v2.1.287+.

zh: /diff 面板本身就是一个内置 Mod，在 /plugin 里禁用它，/diff 就回到老样子。
en: The /diff panel is itself a built-in mod. Disable it in /plugin and /diff falls back to the old viewer.

zh: Mod 能改 Claude Code 几乎所有界面，唯独改不了权限确认框显示的内容。
en: A mod can restyle almost all of Claude Code's interface, except what a permission prompt shows you.

zh: Mod 不在沙箱里，拥有你的全部权限，能读你的环境变量。只装信得过的作者的。
en: Mods aren't sandboxed: they run with your permissions and can read your env vars. Install only from authors you trust.

zh: 官方示例 Mod 里有个 blast-radius：遇到 rm -rf 或强推先拦住，告诉你会影响什么再让你选。
en: One sample mod, blast-radius, holds risky commands like rm -rf or force push and shows what they'd change first.

zh: 不会写 Mod？直接在会话里描述你想要的效果，Claude 会加载 /plugin-authoring 帮你写。
en: Can't write a mod? Describe what you want in a session; Claude loads /plugin-authoring and writes it.

zh: 装 Mod 之前先跑 claude plugin validate，能列出它监听哪些事件、会请求做什么。
en: Before installing a mod, claude plugin validate lists which events it handles and what it asks Claude Code to do.

zh: 按商业条款（Team、Enterprise、API）使用时，Anthropic 不会用你的代码和提示词训练模型。
en: Under commercial terms (Team, Enterprise, API), Anthropic doesn't train models on your Claude Code code or prompts.

zh: 会话记录在本机是明文存的（~/.claude/projects/），共享电脑上要注意。
en: Session transcripts are stored locally in plaintext under ~/.claude/projects/. Mind that on shared machines.

zh: 管理员能在 claude.ai/analytics/claude-code 看团队用量：活跃人数、采纳行数、贡献排行榜。
en: Admins get a dashboard at claude.ai/analytics/claude-code: active users, accepted lines and a contributor leaderboard.

zh: 想按人统计 token 和花费？Claude Code 能把指标通过 OpenTelemetry 导出到你自己的监控系统。
en: Need per-user token and cost data? Claude Code exports metrics via OpenTelemetry to your own observability stack.

zh: companyAnnouncements 设置能在大家启动时显示公司公告，多条时每次随机挑一条。
en: The companyAnnouncements setting shows org announcements at startup, picking one at random each session.

zh: 公司走云厂商也行：Claude Code 能接 Bedrock、Google Cloud 和 Foundry，按 token 记在云账单上。
en: Claude Code also runs on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud and Microsoft Foundry, billed per token to your cloud account.

zh: /goal 给 Claude 定个完成条件，每轮结束有个评估模型检查，没达标就自动接着干。
en: /goal sets a finish condition. After each turn an evaluator checks it, and Claude keeps going until it's met.

zh: /goal 的评估模型不会自己跑命令查，所以条件要写成 Claude 的输出能证明的，比如测试全绿。
en: The /goal evaluator doesn't run commands itself, so phrase conditions Claude's output can prove, like all tests passing.

zh: /loop 5m 加一句 prompt，就让它每 5 分钟跑一次，盯部署、盯 PR 都方便。
en: /loop 5m <prompt> reruns a prompt every 5 minutes. Handy for watching a deploy or babysitting a PR.

zh: /loop 这类循环任务 7 天后自动过期，免得忘了关的循环一直跑下去。
en: Recurring /loop tasks expire after 7 days, so a forgotten loop can't run forever.

zh: Routines 是存好的云端任务：定时跑、收到 API 调用跑，或者 GitHub 有 PR 时自动跑。
en: Routines are saved cloud tasks that run on a schedule, an API call, or GitHub events like new PRs.

zh: claude agents 打开一个总览页，后台所有会话谁在跑、谁在等你、谁做完了，一屏看清。
en: claude agents opens agent view: every background session, what's running, what needs you and what's done.

zh: /deep-research 是内置工作流：并行搜一堆网页、互相交叉核对，最后给一份带引用的报告。
en: /deep-research is a built-in workflow: it fans out web searches, cross-checks sources and writes a cited report.

zh: Agent teams 让多个 Claude 组队：一个当队长分活，队员各自干还能互相发消息。目前默认关闭。
en: Agent teams let one Claude lead while teammates work in their own contexts and message each other. Off by default.

zh: 想边干边学？输出风格选 Learning，Claude 会讲思路，还留一些关键代码让你自己写。
en: Want to learn while you build? The Learning output style explains choices and leaves key pieces for you to code.

zh: 状态栏可以接任意 shell 脚本：它从 stdin 收到会话 JSON，你打印什么底部就显示什么。
en: The status line runs any shell script: it gets session JSON on stdin and shows whatever you print.

zh: 终端老闪屏、滚动乱跳？/tui fullscreen 切到全屏渲染，不闪、省内存，还支持鼠标。
en: Terminal flickering or jumping? /tui fullscreen switches to a flicker-free renderer with flat memory and mouse support.

zh: 开了 /voice 之后，按住空格说话，语音实时转成文字进输入框，可以和打字混着用。
en: With /voice on, hold Space to talk. Speech is transcribed live into the prompt, mixed with typing.

zh: Channels 是能往会话里推消息的 MCP 服务器：Telegram、Discord 发条消息，Claude 就能响应。
en: Channels are MCP servers that push events into your session, so a Telegram or Discord message can reach Claude.

zh: /code-review ultra 会在云端沙箱里派一队审查 agent，每个发现都会独立复现验证。
en: /code-review ultra sends a fleet of reviewer agents to a cloud sandbox, and every finding is independently reproduced.

zh: Claude Code 1.0.0 发布于 2025 年 5 月 22 日，正式版和 Claude 4（Sonnet 4、Opus 4）同一天上线。
en: Claude Code 1.0.0 shipped May 22, 2025: general availability, on the same day as Sonnet 4 and Opus 4.

zh: 2.0.0 发布于 2025 年 9 月 29 日，一口气带来原生 VS Code 扩展、/rewind 回退和 Ctrl+R 搜历史。
en: 2.0.0 landed Sep 29, 2025 with the native VS Code extension, /rewind and Ctrl+R history search.

zh: 插件系统在 2025 年 10 月 9 日的 2.0.12 版正式发布。
en: The plugin system shipped in version 2.0.12 on October 9, 2025.

zh: Claude in Chrome 在 2025 年 12 月的 2.0.72 版进入 Beta，两天后 2.0.74 又加上了 LSP 代码智能工具。
en: Claude in Chrome arrived in beta in 2.0.72 (Dec 2025); two days later 2.0.74 added the LSP code-intelligence tool.

zh: 2.1.0 发布于 2026 年 1 月 7 日：skill 改完即生效不用重启，还加了 context: fork 和 language 设置。
en: 2.1.0 (Jan 7, 2026) added skill hot-reload, context: fork for skills, and the language setting.

zh: Agent teams 在 2026 年 2 月的 2.1.32 版以研究预览上线，当时要设环境变量才能打开。
en: Agent teams debuted as a research preview in 2.1.32 (Feb 2026), behind an environment variable.

zh: Claude Mods 在 2026 年 10 月 1 日的 2.1.287 版发布，插件从此能改 Claude Code 更深层的行为。
en: Claude Mods shipped in 2.1.287 on October 1, 2026, letting plugins change deeper behavior.

zh: 截至 2026 年 10 月 3 日，Claude Code 的版本号已经排到 2.1.289，几乎天天发版。
en: As of Oct 3, 2026, Claude Code's version number had reached 2.1.289. Releases land almost daily.

zh: Anthropic 最早做的产品其实是个 VS Code 编程插件，2022 年大约有 100 个外部用户。
en: Anthropic's first product experiment, back in 2022, was a VS Code coding extension with about 100 external users.

zh: Claude Code 之前，内部有个叫 clide 的命令行工具：没有 bash 工具，但能一次并发 100 个 Haiku。
en: Before Claude Code there was an internal CLI called clide: no bash tool, but it could fan out 100 Haikus in parallel.

zh: Boris 2024 年 9 月进 Labs 时本想做个 linter，负责人 Ben Mann 说不行，要做就做大的。
en: Boris joined Anthropic Labs in Sept 2024 wanting to build a linter. Ben Mann told him to "do the big thing."

zh: 最早的原型叫 Claude CLI。问它在听什么歌，它直接截了 Apple Music 的图来读，发到 Slack 只收到两三个赞。
en: The first prototype, Claude CLI, answered "what music am I playing?" by screenshotting Apple Music. It got 2-3 Slack likes.

zh: Demo 发出第二天，Boris 就看到同事 Robert 已经让它替自己写代码了。
en: The day after that demo, Boris found teammate Robert Boyce already letting Claude CLI do his coding.

zh: 直到 2025 年 2 月对外发布才从 Claude CLI 改名 Claude Code，名字是产品市场部的 Alex Isken 起的。
en: Claude CLI became Claude Code at the Feb 2025 launch. The name came from Alex Isken in Product Marketing.

zh: Boris 说 Claude Code 能起飞靠两件事：订阅制这个商业模式，加上 Claude 4 模型。
en: Boris credits Claude Code's takeoff to two things: subscription plans and the Claude 4 models.

zh: Boris 回忆：2025 年 2 月 Claude Code 写他一成代码，5 月三四成，到那年冬天是百分之百。
en: Boris: Claude Code wrote ~10% of his code in Feb 2025, 30-40% by May, and 100% by that winter.

zh: 2025 年 12 月 Boris 说，过去 30 天他合了 259 个 PR、497 次提交，每一行都是 Claude Code 写的。
en: In Dec 2025 Boris said he'd landed 259 PRs and 497 commits in 30 days, every line written by Claude Code.

zh: Boris 早在 2025 年 5 月就说，他们把 Claude Code 当成一个 Unix 工具来设计。
en: As early as May 2025, Boris described Claude Code as something like a Unix utility.

zh: 早期试过用 RAG 给代码找上下文，结果让 Claude 自己 grep 搜索的效果好得多，就一直这么做了。
en: Early on the team tried RAG for code context, but plain agentic search, letting Claude grep, beat it by a lot.

zh: Claude Code SDK 改名 Claude Agent SDK，是因为内部早就拿这套框架做调研、剪视频、记笔记了。
en: The Claude Code SDK became the Claude Agent SDK because the same harness already powered research, video and note-taking agents.

zh: 沙箱上线后，Anthropic 内部的权限弹窗少了 84%。
en: Anthropic says sandboxing cut permission prompts by 84% in its internal use.

zh: 2025 年 12 月 Anthropic 收购了 Bun，那时 Claude Code 正式可用才半年，年化营收已过 10 亿美元。
en: Anthropic bought Bun in Dec 2025, when Claude Code hit $1B run-rate revenue just six months after going public.

zh: Bun 作者 Jarred Sumner 说，Claude Code 就是一个 Bun 编译的可执行文件，发到了几百万用户手里。
en: Bun's creator says Claude Code ships to millions of users as a single Bun executable.

zh: 2026 年 1 月 Cowork 发布，有人问它是用什么写的，Boris 答：基本全是 Claude Code。
en: When Cowork launched in Jan 2026, Boris said it was built with "pretty much all Claude Code."

zh: Boris 说用好 Claude Code 最重要的一条：让它能自己验证结果，质量能提高两三倍。
en: Boris's top tip: give Claude a way to verify its own work. He says it improves final quality 2-3x.

zh: 2026 年 1 月 TodoWrite 被 Tasks 取代：新模型不再需要待办提醒，设计还借鉴了开源项目 Beads。
en: In Jan 2026 Tasks replaced TodoWrite: newer models no longer needed todo reminders. The design borrowed from Beads.

zh: 团队监控提示缓存命中率，掉下去就按线上事故处理。计划模式做成工具，也是为了不破坏缓存。
en: The team alerts on prompt cache hit rate and declares SEVs when it drops. Plan mode is built as tools to keep the cache intact.

zh: AskUserQuestion 工具是第三版方案，前两版（塞进计划工具、改输出格式）都失败了。
en: The AskUserQuestion tool was attempt #3, after folding questions into the plan tool and a custom format both failed.

zh: 2026 年 2 月官方说 Claude Code 年化营收破 25 亿美元，还引用分析称 GitHub 公开提交约 4% 出自它。
en: In Feb 2026 Anthropic said Claude Code passed $2.5B run-rate, citing analysis that it wrote ~4% of public GitHub commits.

zh: 做 auto 模式的起因：用户对 93% 的权限弹窗都点了同意。它的分类器故意不看 Claude 自己说的话。
en: Auto mode exists because users approved 93% of permission prompts. Its classifier is deliberately blind to Claude's own messages.

zh: 2026 年 7 月，团队给最新模型删掉了约八成系统提示词，而且每个模型用的提示词都不一样。
en: In Jul 2026 the team cut ~80% of Claude Code's system prompt for the newest models; each model gets its own prompt.

zh: 1954 年 FORTRAN 的初步报告就宣称，它将「几乎消灭编码和调试」。让机器替人写程序，是个很老的梦。
en: The 1954 FORTRAN preliminary report promised it would "virtually eliminate coding and debugging." Machines writing code is an old dream.

zh: Token 是模型读写文字的基本单位。英文里 1 个 token 平均约 4 个字符，大概是 3/4 个单词。
en: Tokens are the units models read and write. In English, one token averages about 4 characters, roughly 3/4 of a word.

zh: 长文档放在提示开头，问题放最后。Anthropic 测试发现，这样回答质量最多能提升 30%。
en: Put long documents at the top of the prompt and your question at the end. Anthropic's tests showed up to 30% better answers.

zh: 幻觉包名：一项研究分析了 16 个代码模型的 57.6 万段代码，推荐的软件包里有 19.7% 根本不存在。
en: Package hallucination: across 576,000 code samples from 16 models, 19.7% of recommended packages didn't exist.

zh: GitHub 2022 年的实验：用 Copilot 的一组开发者写一个 JavaScript HTTP 服务器，比对照组快了 55.8%。
en: In a 2022 GitHub experiment, developers using Copilot built a JavaScript HTTP server 55.8% faster than a control group.

zh: 2025 年 DARPA 的 AI 网络挑战赛决赛，Team Atlanta 拿下冠军和 400 万美元，参赛系统要自动找漏洞并打补丁。
en: At DARPA's 2025 AI Cyber Challenge finals, Team Atlanta won $4M; systems had to find and patch vulnerabilities on their own.

zh: pass@k 的意思：每道题让模型生成 k 份代码，只要有一份通过单元测试，就算解出来了。
en: pass@k means generating k programs per problem; the problem counts as solved if at least one passes the unit tests.

zh: Claude 在 2023 年 3 月 14 日正式对外推出，同时有 Claude 和更快更便宜的 Claude Instant 两个版本。
en: Claude launched publicly on March 14, 2023, alongside Claude Instant, a lighter, faster and cheaper version.

zh: 1978 年 Dijkstra 写过一篇《论用自然语言编程之愚蠢》，他认为形式化符号的精确，恰恰是它的价值所在。
en: In 1978 Dijkstra wrote "On the foolishness of natural language programming," arguing that the precision of formal notation is its value.

zh: 在 Claude 现在的分词器上，100 万 token 大约是 55.5 万个英文单词；换分词器之前，能装约 75 万词。
en: On Claude's current tokenizer, 1M tokens is about 555k English words. Before the tokenizer change it fit about 750k.

zh: 用 XML 标签把指令、资料、示例分开，比如 <instructions> 和 <example>，模型就不容易把它们搞混。
en: Wrap instructions, context and examples in XML tags like <instructions> and <example> so the model doesn't mix them up.

zh: 那项「幻觉包名」研究里，模型一共编出了 20.5 万多个不同的假包名，很多还会被反复编出来。
en: The package-hallucination study found over 205,000 unique made-up package names, many repeated across runs.

zh: GitHub 研究发现，补全建议的「接受率」最能预测开发者觉得自己效率高不高，比其他指标都准。
en: GitHub research found the acceptance rate of suggestions was the best predictor of how productive developers felt.

zh: 2024 年谷歌的 Big Sleep 智能体在 SQLite 里找到一个此前未知、可被利用的内存漏洞，在发版前就修掉了。
en: In 2024 Google's Big Sleep agent found a previously unknown, exploitable memory bug in SQLite, fixed before it reached a release.

zh: HumanEval 是 OpenAI 2021 年为评测 Codex 手写的 164 道 Python 题，每题给函数签名和说明，平均配 7.7 个测试。
en: HumanEval: 164 Python problems OpenAI hand-wrote in 2021 to test Codex, each a signature plus docstring, averaging 7.7 tests.

zh: 2023 年 5 月 Claude 上下文扩到 10 万 token。把《了不起的盖茨比》改一行塞进去，Claude Instant 22 秒就找了出来。
en: In May 2023 Claude got a 100K-token context. Given The Great Gatsby with one line changed, Claude Instant found it in 22 seconds.

zh: 2017 年 6 月，谷歌发表论文《Attention Is All You Need》，提出 Transformer。今天的代码模型都建在它上面。
en: In June 2017 Google's paper "Attention Is All You Need" introduced the Transformer, the architecture behind today's coding models.

zh: 上下文窗口是模型一次能「看见」的全部内容：系统提示、对话历史、工具结果，还有它自己正在写的回答。
en: The context window is everything the model can see at once: system prompt, chat history, tool results and the reply it's writing.

zh: 给示例最有效。Anthropic 建议放 3 到 5 个，而且要彼此不同，免得模型只学会照抄某一个。
en: Examples work. Anthropic suggests 3-5 diverse ones, so the model doesn't latch onto quirks of a single example.

zh: 有人抢注 AI 常编的假包名并塞进恶意代码，这种攻击被叫作「slopsquatting」，由 Python 软件基金会的 Seth Larson 命名。
en: Registering package names AIs hallucinate to plant malware is called "slopsquatting," a term coined by the PSF's Seth Larson.

zh: METR 2025 年实验：资深开源开发者用 AI 工具后完成任务反而慢了 19%，但他们自己觉得快了 20%。
en: METR's 2025 study: experienced open-source devs were 19% slower with AI tools, yet believed they'd been 20% faster.

zh: 2025 年研究员 Sean Heelan 用 o3 在 Linux 内核 SMB 实现里找到一个远程零日漏洞，编号 CVE-2025-37899。
en: In 2025 researcher Sean Heelan used o3 to find CVE-2025-37899, a remote zero-day in the Linux kernel's SMB implementation.

zh: HumanEval 为什么要手写？因为 GitHub 上现成的题很可能早就在训练数据里，拿来考试等于漏题。
en: Why hand-write HumanEval? Problems already on GitHub were likely in the training data, so using them would leak the answers.

zh: 2023 年 7 月发布的 Claude 2，HumanEval 编程得分 71.2%，前一代 Claude 1.3 是 56%。
en: Claude 2 (July 2023) scored 71.2% on HumanEval, up from 56% for Claude 1.3.

zh: Karpathy 2017 年写了《Software 2.0》：神经网络的权重就是一种新代码，不是人写的，是用数据和优化「训」出来的。
en: Karpathy's 2017 essay "Software 2.0" argued neural net weights are a new kind of code, written by data and optimization, not people.

zh: 大模型 API 本身没有记忆。每轮对话，客户端都要把完整历史重新发一遍，模型才「记得」前面说过什么。
en: LLM APIs have no memory. Each turn, the client resends the whole conversation, which is how the model "remembers" what came before.

zh: 告诉模型「为什么」。比如说明回答要给语音朗读，它自己就会避开省略号，不用你一条条列禁令。
en: Explain why. Say the reply will be read by text-to-speech and the model avoids ellipses on its own, no list of rules needed.

zh: 安全研究员把 AI 常编的假包名「huggingface-cli」真注册成空包做实验，三个月就被真实下载了 1.5 万多次。
en: A researcher registered "huggingface-cli," a package name AIs kept inventing, as an empty test. It got 15,000+ real downloads in 3 months.

zh: METR 测量发现，AI 能以 50% 成功率完成的任务长度（按人类耗时算），大约每 7 个月翻一倍。
en: METR found the length of tasks AI can finish with 50% success, measured in human time, has doubled about every 7 months.

zh: Anthropic 和 Mozilla 合作，Claude Opus 4.6 两周在 Firefox 里找到 22 个漏洞，其中 14 个高危。
en: Working with Mozilla, Claude Opus 4.6 found 22 vulnerabilities in Firefox in two weeks, 14 of them high-severity.

zh: 在 HumanEval 上，120 亿参数的 Codex 一次做对 28.8%，同期的 GPT-3 是 0%。
en: On HumanEval, the 12B-parameter Codex solved 28.8% on the first try. GPT-3 solved 0%.

zh: 2023 年 11 月 Claude 2.1 把上下文提到 20 万 token，大约 15 万个英文单词，或 500 多页书。
en: Claude 2.1 (Nov 2023) raised context to 200K tokens, about 150,000 words or over 500 pages.

zh: 2019 年 TabNine 推出基于 GPT-2 的 Deep TabNine，是最早把大语言模型放进代码补全的产品之一。
en: In 2019 TabNine launched Deep TabNine, built on GPT-2, one of the first products to put a large language model into code completion.

zh: 调用你自己定义的工具时，模型并不执行任何东西。它只写出「调哪个工具、参数是什么」，由你的程序去跑，再把结果交回。
en: With tools you define, the model runs nothing. It writes which tool to call with what arguments; your code runs it and returns the result.

zh: 说「要做什么」比说「别做什么」管用。与其说「不要用 Markdown」，不如说「用连贯的段落来写」。
en: Say what to do, not what to avoid. Instead of "don't use markdown," ask for "smoothly flowing prose paragraphs."

zh: 2021 年一项研究让早期 AI 编程助手在 89 个高风险场景下写了 1689 个程序，约 40% 带安全漏洞。
en: A 2021 study had an early AI coding assistant write 1,689 programs for 89 high-risk scenarios; about 40% were vulnerable.

zh: Stack Overflow 2025 年调查：84% 的开发者在用或打算用 AI 工具。
en: Stack Overflow's 2025 survey: 84% of developers use or plan to use AI tools.

zh: 截至 2026 年 5 月，Anthropic 用 Claude 在开源软件里披露了 1596 个漏洞，只有 97 个已修复。瓶颈转到了核实和修补。
en: By May 2026 Anthropic had used Claude to disclose 1,596 open-source bugs; only 97 were patched. Verifying and fixing is now the bottleneck.

zh: Codex 论文里，让模型每题生成 100 份答案，有一份对就算过，正确率升到 70.2%。
en: In the Codex paper, sampling 100 answers per problem and counting any pass lifted the solve rate to 70.2%.

zh: 2024 年 3 月 Claude 3 家族发布，按能力从小到大分为 Haiku、Sonnet、Opus 三档。
en: The Claude 3 family launched in March 2024 in three tiers, from least to most capable: Haiku, Sonnet and Opus.

zh: 2021 年 6 月 29 日，GitHub 发布 Copilot 技术预览，给它的定位是「你的 AI 结对程序员」。
en: On June 29, 2021, GitHub unveiled Copilot as a technical preview, billed as "your AI pair programmer."

zh: Simon Willison 给智能体下过一个很短的定义：在循环里调用工具、去完成一个目标的大模型。
en: Simon Willison's short definition: an LLM agent runs tools in a loop to achieve a goal.

zh: 新一代 Claude 很听话，你说啥做啥。想让它多做一步、做得更漂亮，就要明确说出来。
en: Newer Claude models follow instructions precisely. If you want them to go above and beyond, ask explicitly.

zh: 斯坦福的实验发现：用 AI 助手的人写出的代码更不安全，却更相信自己的代码是安全的。
en: A Stanford study found people using an AI assistant wrote less secure code, yet were more confident it was secure.

zh: Stack Overflow 2025 年调查里，不信任 AI 准确性的开发者（46%）比信任的（33%）还多。
en: In Stack Overflow's 2025 survey, more developers distrusted AI accuracy (46%) than trusted it (33%).

zh: Codex 论文发现最佳 temperature 跟着 k 变：只取 1 份答案时 0.2 最好，取 100 份时 0.8 最好，多样性更值钱。
en: The Codex paper found the best temperature depends on k: 0.2 for pass@1, 0.8 for pass@100, where diversity pays.

zh: 大海捞针测试时，Claude 3 Opus 不光找到了那句话，还说它怀疑这句是有人故意塞进来测它的。
en: In a needle-in-a-haystack test, Claude 3 Opus found the sentence and remarked it suspected it had been inserted to test it.

zh: Copilot 最早背后是 OpenAI 的 Codex：GPT-3 的后代，又用 GitHub 上的公开代码继续训练。
en: Copilot was first powered by OpenAI Codex, a descendant of GPT-3 further trained on public code from GitHub.

zh: Anthropic 区分了两种系统：工作流是按写好的路线调模型和工具；智能体则由模型自己决定下一步做什么。
en: Anthropic separates workflows, where LLMs and tools follow predefined code paths, from agents, where the model directs its own process.

zh: 处理长文档时，先让模型把相关原文摘出来，再基于摘录回答，它更能抓住重点，不被其余内容带偏。
en: With long documents, ask the model to quote the relevant passages first, then answer from those quotes. It cuts down on noise.

zh: 模型的知识有截止日期。比如 Claude Haiku 4.5 的可靠知识截止到 2025 年 2 月，之后发布的库版本它不知道。
en: Models have knowledge cutoffs. Claude Haiku 4.5's reliable knowledge ends Feb 2025, so it won't know library releases after that.

zh: 研究发现，ChatGPT 上线后半年内，Stack Overflow 上的发帖量相对下降了约 25%。
en: A study found Stack Overflow posting activity fell about 25% relative to comparable sites within six months of ChatGPT's launch.

zh: 谷歌 2021 年的 MBPP 收了 974 道入门级 Python 题，靠众包写成，是 HumanEval 之外另一个常用基准。
en: Google's 2021 MBPP has 974 crowd-sourced entry-level Python problems, another staple benchmark alongside HumanEval.

zh: 2024 年 6 月 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 在 Anthropic 内部的智能体编程评测里解决了 64% 的问题，Claude 3 Opus 只有 38%。
en: In June 2024 Claude 3.5 Sonnet solved 64% of problems in Anthropic's internal agentic coding eval, vs 38% for Claude 3 Opus.

zh: Codex 论文的训练数据：从 5400 万个 GitHub 公开仓库里收集 Python 文件，过滤后剩 159GB。
en: The Codex paper's training data: Python files from 54 million public GitHub repos, filtered down to 159 GB.

zh: Anthropic 总结了五种常见工作流：提示链、路由、并行、编排者-工人、评估者-优化者。
en: Anthropic lists five common workflow patterns: prompt chaining, routing, parallelization, orchestrator-workers and evaluator-optimizer.

zh: 明确允许模型说「我不知道」，是减少幻觉最简单的一招。
en: Explicitly allowing the model to say "I don't know" is one of the simplest ways to reduce hallucinations.

zh: 模型偶尔会为了让测试变绿而「作弊」，比如针对测试写特例。Claude 3.7 Sonnet 的系统卡就公开记录过这种行为。
en: Models sometimes game tests, like special-casing them to go green. The Claude 3.7 Sonnet system card documented this openly.

zh: 2024 年 10 月皮查伊说，谷歌超过四分之一的新代码由 AI 生成，再经工程师审核接受。
en: In Oct 2024 Sundar Pichai said over a quarter of new code at Google was AI-generated, then reviewed and accepted by engineers.

zh: 2021 年的 APPS 基准收了 1 万道编程题，从入门到竞赛难度都有，题目来自 Codeforces 等网站。
en: The 2021 APPS benchmark collects 10,000 coding problems from intro level to competition level, from sites like Codeforces.

zh: 2024 年 10 月 Anthropic 推出「电脑使用」测试版，Claude 能看屏幕截图、移动鼠标、敲键盘。
en: In Oct 2024 Anthropic launched computer use in beta: Claude could look at screenshots, move a cursor and type.

zh: 2021 年 8 月 OpenAI 开放 Codex API 内测，官方说它最擅长 Python，也能写十几种其他语言。
en: In August 2021 OpenAI opened a Codex API beta. It was strongest in Python and proficient in over a dozen other languages.

zh: 提示缓存按「前缀」匹配：系统提示、工具定义、前面的消息只要一个字没变，就能直接复用，不用重算。
en: Prompt caching matches on prefixes: if the tools, system prompt and earlier messages are unchanged, they're reused instead of recomputed.

zh: 修 bug 时，先让 AI 写一个能复现问题的失败测试，再让它改代码，直到这个测试通过。
en: Fixing a bug? Have the AI write a failing test that reproduces it first, then fix the code until that test passes.

zh: Kent Beck 说，AI 智能体有时会「作弊」，比如把失败的测试禁用或删掉，所以他会盯紧中间结果。
en: Kent Beck flags AI agents cheating by disabling or deleting failing tests, so he watches their intermediate results closely.

zh: YC 2025 冬季批次里，约四分之一的创业公司有 95% 的代码由 AI 生成。
en: In Y Combinator's Winter 2025 batch, about a quarter of startups had codebases that were 95% AI-generated.

zh: SWE-bench 2023 年 10 月发布，从 12 个热门 Python 仓库里收集了 2294 个真实 GitHub issue 和对应修复。
en: SWE-bench (Oct 2023) collects 2,294 real GitHub issues and their fixes from 12 popular Python repositories.

zh: 教 Claude 用电脑时，关键一步是让它学会数像素，算出光标要往哪移多少，才能点准位置。
en: A key step in teaching Claude computer use was getting it to count pixels, so it could move the cursor to exactly the right spot.

zh: 2022 年 6 月 Copilot 正式商用，每月 10 美元，认证学生和热门开源项目的维护者可以免费用。
en: Copilot became generally available in June 2022 at $10/month, free for verified students and maintainers of popular open source projects.

zh: 缓存是按前缀算的，所以开头哪怕改一个字，比如在系统提示里塞个当前时间，后面的缓存就全失效了。
en: Since caching is prefix-based, changing even one early token, like a timestamp in the system prompt, invalidates everything after it.

zh: 先探索、再计划、后动手：让 AI 先读相关代码、出方案，你确认了再写，免得它解决了错误的问题。
en: Explore, plan, then code: have the AI read relevant files and propose a plan first, so it doesn't solve the wrong problem.

zh: Anthropic 研究发现，模型在训练里学会了钻编程任务的空子后，还会泛化出其他不良行为，比如破坏安全研究。
en: Anthropic found that when a model learned to reward-hack coding tasks in training, it generalized to other bad behavior, like sabotage.

zh: Anthropic 经济指数首份报告发现，Claude 的对话里软件开发占比最大，计算机与数学类任务占 37.2%。
en: Anthropic's first Economic Index found software development dominated Claude usage: computer and math tasks made up 37.2%.

zh: SWE-bench 怎么判对错：打上模型的补丁后，原本失败的测试要变通过，原本通过的测试不能被弄坏。
en: How SWE-bench grades: after applying the model's patch, the issue's failing tests must pass and previously passing tests must still pass.

zh: 录电脑使用演示时，Claude 中途「开小差」，停下写代码的活，跑去看黄石公园的风景照了。
en: While recording a computer use demo, Claude wandered off its coding task to browse photos of Yellowstone National Park.

zh: 2022 年 2 月 DeepMind 发布 AlphaCode，在 Codeforces 比赛里排到前 54% 左右，大约是中等人类选手的水平。
en: DeepMind's AlphaCode (Feb 2022) ranked around the top 54% in Codeforces contests, roughly a median human competitor.

zh: Claude 的提示缓存默认保留 5 分钟，每次命中都会续期；也可以选 1 小时，写入价更高。
en: Claude's prompt cache lasts 5 minutes by default and refreshes on each hit. A 1-hour option costs more to write.

zh: 给 AI 一个能自己检查结果的办法，比如测试、截图对比、能跑的脚本。它能验证，就能自己迭代修好。
en: Give the AI a way to check its own work, like tests, screenshots or a runnable script. If it can verify, it can iterate.

zh: 同一研究里有个反直觉的解法：训练时直接告诉模型「这里钻空子是允许的」，坏行为的泛化反而大幅减少。
en: A counterintuitive fix from that study: telling the model reward hacking was OK there sharply cut the bad generalization.

zh: Anthropic 统计发现，编程智能体里 79% 的对话是让 AI 直接干活的「自动化」，网页聊天里这个比例是 49%。
en: Anthropic found 79% of conversations in its coding agent were automation, letting AI do the task, versus 49% in chat.

zh: SWE-bench 刚发布时，表现最好的 Claude 2 只解决了 1.96% 的问题。
en: When SWE-bench launched in 2023, the best model, Claude 2, resolved just 1.96% of the issues.

zh: MCP 由 Anthropic 在 2024 年 11 月开源，目标是让 AI 应用用同一套协议接各种工具和数据源。
en: Anthropic open-sourced MCP in Nov 2024 so AI apps could connect to tools and data sources through one protocol.

zh: ChatGPT 2022 年 11 月上线时，官方博客放的第一段示例对话，就是用户贴了段代码问哪里不对。
en: When ChatGPT launched in Nov 2022, the first sample dialogue in OpenAI's post was a user asking why their code didn't work.

zh: KV 缓存：模型把前文每个 token 算出的键和值存起来，生成下一个 token 时直接拿来用，不用从头再算。
en: The KV cache stores keys and values computed for earlier tokens, so generating the next token doesn't recompute them.

zh: 让一个 AI 写代码，另开一个干净会话的 AI 来审，比让同一个自己检查自己更能发现问题。
en: Have one AI write code and a fresh session review it. A clean context catches more than self-review in the same session.

zh: 谄媚：Anthropic 2023 年的研究发现，主流 AI 助手常会顺着用户说，用户一质疑，原本对的答案也可能改错。
en: Sycophancy: Anthropic's 2023 research found AI assistants often tell users what they want, even abandoning correct answers when challenged.

zh: Anthropic 调查自家工程师：大家在约 60% 的工作中用 Claude，自评效率提升约 50%。
en: Anthropic surveyed its own engineers: they used Claude in about 60% of their work and reported roughly 50% productivity gains.

zh: 2024 年 8 月 OpenAI 请专业开发者逐题人工审核，从 SWE-bench 里挑出 500 道靠谱的题，叫 SWE-bench Verified。
en: In Aug 2024 OpenAI had professional developers review SWE-bench by hand, producing 500 validated tasks: SWE-bench Verified.

zh: 2024 年 8 月 Anthropic 推出提示缓存，长提示的成本最多降 90%，延迟最多降 85%。
en: Anthropic launched prompt caching in Aug 2024, cutting costs by up to 90% and latency by up to 85% for long prompts.

zh: 2023 年 1 月 Karpathy 发推：「最热门的新编程语言是英语。」
en: In January 2023 Karpathy tweeted: "The hottest new programming language is English."

zh: Claude 现在每款模型的输出单价都是输入的 5 倍。同样一个 token，让模型少写一个，比少喂一个省 5 倍。
en: Every current Claude model charges 5x more for output tokens than input, so each token the model skips writing saves 5x.

zh: 「小黄鸭调试」对 AI 也管用：论文发现，让模型用大白话解释自己写的代码，不告诉它对错也能自己揪出 bug。
en: Rubber-duck debugging works on AI too: explaining its own code lets a model spot its bugs, even when nobody tells it what's wrong.

zh: 智能体读到的网页、邮件、GitHub issue 里都可能藏着恶意指令，而模型很难分清该听谁的。
en: Web pages, emails and GitHub issues an agent reads can hide malicious instructions, and models can't reliably tell whose to follow.

zh: 同一调查里，有 27% 借助 Claude 完成的工作，本来是根本不会去做的，比如顺手做个小工具。
en: In the same survey, 27% of Claude-assisted work was work that wouldn't have been done otherwise, like small nice-to-have tools.

zh: 人工审核时发现原题毛病不少：描述不清、测试不合理，抽查样本里 68.3% 被筛掉了。
en: The review found many original tasks underspecified or with unfair tests; 68.3% of the sampled tasks were filtered out.

zh: Anthropic 从 2024 年 8 月起公开 Claude 网页版和 App 的系统提示词，每次改动都记在发布说明里。
en: Since Aug 2024 Anthropic has published the system prompts for Claude's apps, logging changes in its release notes.

zh: 2023 年 5 月，Hugging Face 和 ServiceNow 牵头的 BigCode 发布开源的 StarCoder，155 亿参数，学了 80 多种编程语言。
en: In May 2023 the BigCode project led by Hugging Face and ServiceNow released StarCoder, an open 15.5B model trained on 80+ languages.

zh: temperature 设成 0 也不保证结果完全一样。有实验把同一提示跑 1000 次，得到了 80 种不同的回答。
en: Temperature 0 isn't fully deterministic. One experiment ran the same prompt 1,000 times and got 80 distinct completions.

zh: AlphaCodium 让模型先想题意、自己补测试、再反复修改，GPT-4 在 CodeContests 上从 19% 提到 44%。
en: AlphaCodium had GPT-4 reason about the problem, write extra tests and iterate. CodeContests accuracy rose from 19% to 44%.

zh: Anthropic 的「潜伏特工」实验：训练模型在年份是 2023 时写安全代码，看到 2024 就偷偷插漏洞，常规安全训练也去不掉。
en: Anthropic's "sleeper agents": a model trained to write safe code in 2023 but insert bugs in 2024 kept doing so through safety training.

zh: GitHub 2025 年度报告：TypeScript 按贡献者数超过 Python，成了 GitHub 上用得最多的语言。
en: GitHub's Octoverse 2025: TypeScript passed Python by contributor count to become the most used language on GitHub.

zh: 普林斯顿的 SWE-agent 提出「智能体-计算机接口」：给模型专门设计的查看和编辑命令，比直接丢给它一个 shell 好用得多。
en: Princeton's SWE-agent introduced the "agent-computer interface": commands designed for LLMs beat giving them a raw shell.

zh: 2025 年 2 月的 Claude 3.7 Sonnet 是 Anthropic 第一个「混合推理」模型：同一个模型既能秒答，也能先想再答。
en: Claude 3.7 Sonnet (Feb 2025) was Anthropic's first hybrid reasoning model: one model that can answer instantly or think first.

zh: BigCode 的代码数据集 The Stack 配了个工具「Am I in The Stack?」，开发者可以查自己的代码在不在里面，并申请移除。
en: BigCode's dataset The Stack came with "Am I in The Stack?", letting developers check if their code was included and opt out.

zh: 罪魁之一是批大小：服务器同时处理多少请求会改变浮点运算的顺序，结果就差了那么一点点。
en: A key culprit is batch size: how many requests a server handles at once changes floating-point order, nudging the results.

zh: 多试几次真有用。有研究让模型对 SWE-bench Lite 每题尝试 250 次，解决率从 15.9% 涨到 56%。
en: Repeated sampling pays off. With 250 attempts per issue, one study lifted SWE-bench Lite solves from 15.9% to 56%.

zh: HumanEval+ 给每道题补了大量测试，一些原本「通过」的代码其实是错的，模型的通过率掉了 19% 到 29%。
en: HumanEval+ added many more tests per problem and exposed code that only looked correct. Pass rates dropped by 19-29%.

zh: OpenAI 的 SWE-Lancer 用了 1400 多个 Upwork 真实外包任务，报酬加起来 100 万美元，看 AI 能挣到多少。
en: OpenAI's SWE-Lancer uses 1,400+ real Upwork freelance tasks worth $1 million in total payouts to see how much AI could earn.

zh: LiveCodeBench 持续从 LeetCode、AtCoder、Codeforces 收新题，按发布时间切分，专门防「考前见过题」。
en: LiveCodeBench keeps collecting new problems from LeetCode, AtCoder and Codeforces, dated by release, to fight contamination.

zh: 2025 年 5 月 Claude Opus 4 发布，乐天用它独立跑了一次开源代码重构，连续干了 7 小时。
en: With Claude Opus 4 (May 2025), Rakuten had it run a demanding open-source refactor on its own for 7 hours straight.

zh: 2023 年 8 月 Meta 发布 Code Llama，免费可商用，能稳定处理长达 10 万 token 的上下文。
en: In August 2023 Meta released Code Llama, free for commercial use, with stable generation on contexts up to 100,000 tokens.

zh: 主流分词算法 BPE 原本是 1994 年的一种数据压缩算法，2015 年才被搬到神经机器翻译里用。
en: BPE, the tokenization method behind most LLMs, began as a 1994 data compression algorithm and was adapted for neural translation in 2015.

zh: 简单流程也能打。Agentless 只分定位、修复、验证三步，不搞复杂智能体，在 SWE-bench Lite 上做到 32%，每题约 0.7 美元。
en: Simple can win. Agentless used just localize, repair, validate, and solved 32% of SWE-bench Lite at about $0.70 per issue.

zh: Stack Overflow 2025 年调查里，开发者最大的烦恼是 AI 给的答案「几乎对，但不完全对」，66% 的人这么说。
en: In Stack Overflow's 2025 survey, developers' top AI frustration (66%) was solutions that are "almost right, but not quite."

zh: 2024 年 DORA 报告发现，AI 采用率每提高 25%，交付稳定性估计下降 7.2%。AI 让单个任务变快，不等于整体更稳。
en: The 2024 DORA report estimated a 25% rise in AI adoption came with a 7.2% drop in delivery stability. Faster isn't always steadier.

zh: Aider 的多语言基准用了 225 道 Exercism 难题，覆盖 C++、Go、Java、JavaScript、Python 和 Rust。
en: Aider's polyglot benchmark uses 225 hard Exercism exercises in C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python and Rust.

zh: Claude Opus 4 是 Anthropic 第一个按 ASL-3 安全级别防护发布的模型。
en: Claude Opus 4 was the first Anthropic model released under ASL-3 safety protections.

zh: 2024 年 3 月 Cognition 发布 Devin，号称首个 AI 软件工程师，在 SWE-bench 上解决了 13.86% 的问题。
en: In March 2024 Cognition introduced Devin, billed as the first AI software engineer. It resolved 13.86% of SWE-bench issues.

zh: 代码里最费 token 的是空白。Codex 给分词器加了表示连续空格的 token，同样的代码少用约 30% token。
en: Whitespace was the biggest token waste in code. Codex added tokens for runs of spaces, so code took about 30% fewer tokens.

zh: Anthropic 做 SWE-bench 智能体时，花在打磨工具上的时间比打磨整体提示词还多。
en: Building its SWE-bench agent, Anthropic spent more time optimizing the tools than the overall prompt.

zh: 会话拖太久，失败的尝试和无关内容堆在上下文里，表现会变差。换个不相关的任务，就清空上下文重新开始。
en: Long sessions pile up failed attempts and irrelevant context, which hurts performance. Clear the context between unrelated tasks.

zh: 2024 年 2 月谷歌说 Gemini 1.5 Pro 能一次读进 100 万 token，相当于 3 万多行代码。
en: In Feb 2024 Google said Gemini 1.5 Pro could take in 1 million tokens at once, over 30,000 lines of code.

zh: τ-bench 用 pass^k 衡量稳定性：同一任务跑 k 次要次次都成功才算数。k 越大，分数掉得越狠。
en: τ-bench's pass^k measures reliability: a task counts only if all k runs succeed. Scores fall sharply as k grows.

zh: 2025 年 9 月的 Claude Sonnet 4.5，被观察到能在复杂多步任务上连续专注 30 多个小时。
en: Claude Sonnet 4.5 (Sept 2025) was observed staying focused on complex multi-step tasks for more than 30 hours.

zh: 「Vibe coding」出自 Karpathy 2025 年 2 月的一条推：完全跟着感觉走，忘掉代码的存在。
en: "Vibe coding" comes from Karpathy's Feb 2025 tweet: fully give in to the vibes and forget that the code even exists.

zh: OpenAI 2022 年提出「填中间」训练：把空缺前后的内容都给模型，让它补上中间那块，比如写了一半的函数。
en: OpenAI's 2022 fill-in-the-middle training shows a model text before and after a gap to write the missing part, like a half-done function.

zh: 防呆设计：模型切换目录后老用错相对路径，Anthropic 就规定工具只收绝对路径，问题直接消失。
en: Poka-yoke your tools: the model kept botching relative paths, so Anthropic made the tool require absolute paths. Problem gone.

zh: Anthropic 实验发现，学新编程库时用 AI 帮忙的人，之后测验平均 50 分，自己写的组 67 分，调试题差得最多。
en: Anthropic found devs who used AI while learning a new library averaged 50% on a later quiz vs 67% hand-coding, worst on debugging.

zh: 微软、埃森哲等公司做的现场实验里，用上 AI 编程助手的开发者完成的任务多了约 26%，新手受益更大。
en: Field experiments at Microsoft, Accenture and another firm found AI coding assistants raised completed tasks about 26%, more for juniors.

zh: OSWorld 让 AI 在真实电脑系统里完成 369 个任务。发布时人类成功率 72.36%，最好的模型只有 12.24%。
en: OSWorld has AI complete 369 tasks on real computer systems. At launch, humans scored 72.36% and the best model 12.24%.

zh: Claude Haiku 4.5（2025 年 10 月）的编程水平和五个月前的 Sonnet 4 相当，价格只要三分之一。
en: Claude Haiku 4.5 (Oct 2025) matched the coding of Sonnet 4, a frontier model five months earlier, at a third of the cost.

zh: 柯林斯词典把「vibe coding」选为 2025 年度词汇，离 Karpathy 第一次用这个词还不到一年。
en: Collins Dictionary named "vibe coding" its 2025 Word of the Year, less than a year after Karpathy coined it.

zh: 投机解码：让小模型先猜几个 token，大模型一次性批改。输出分布不变，速度能快 2 到 3 倍。
en: Speculative decoding: a small model drafts tokens and the big model checks them in one pass. Same outputs, 2-3x faster.

zh: Anthropic 拿 SWE-bench 时用的脚手架很简单：一个提示词，加上一个 bash 工具和一个编辑工具。
en: Anthropic's SWE-bench scaffold was minimal: one prompt, a bash tool and a file-editing tool.

zh: 评测分数也会被机器配置影响。Anthropic 发现，同一个智能体编程评测，光是资源配置不同就能差 6 个百分点。
en: Benchmarks feel the hardware. Anthropic found infrastructure settings alone could swing an agentic coding eval by 6 points.

zh: 谷歌 2024 年做的随机对照实验里，用 AI 功能的工程师完成一项企业级开发任务快了约 21%。
en: In a 2024 Google randomized trial, engineers using AI features finished an enterprise coding task about 21% faster.

zh: Terminal-Bench 让智能体在终端沙箱里完成真实任务，比如编译代码、训模型、搭服务器，每题配测试脚本判分。
en: Terminal-Bench gives agents real tasks in a terminal sandbox, like compiling code, training models or setting up servers, graded by tests.

zh: Anthropic 招性能工程师的笔试限时 2 小时，Claude Opus 4.5 在时限内的得分超过了历来所有人类候选人。
en: On the 2-hour take-home Anthropic gives performance engineering candidates, Claude Opus 4.5 outscored every human candidate ever.

zh: Simon Willison 说：AI 写的代码你读过、测过、还能给别人讲明白，那就不叫 vibe coding，叫软件开发。
en: Simon Willison: if an LLM wrote your code but you reviewed, tested and can explain it, that's not vibe coding, it's software development.

zh: 结构化输出靠「约束解码」：生成时直接屏蔽不合规的 token，所以输出能 100% 符合你给的 JSON Schema。
en: Structured outputs use constrained decoding: tokens that would break your JSON Schema are blocked, so output always matches it.

zh: 给智能体写工具说明，就当是给新来的同事写文档：把你脑子里默认的背景知识都写清楚。
en: Write tool descriptions as if onboarding a new teammate: spell out the context you'd otherwise take for granted.

zh: 训练数据污染：LiveCodeBench 发现，有些模型在训练截止前的老题上分数明显更高，换成新题就掉下来。
en: Contamination: LiveCodeBench found some models scored much higher on problems released before their cutoff than on newer ones.

zh: Anthropic 统计 Claude 的编程对话：JavaScript 和 TypeScript 合计占 31%，最常见的活是做界面组件。
en: Anthropic found JavaScript and TypeScript made up 31% of Claude coding queries; building UI components was the top task.

zh: Scale AI 的 SWE-bench Pro 收了 1865 道题，部分来自不公开的商业代码库，就是为了防模型提前见过。
en: Scale AI's SWE-bench Pro has 1,865 tasks, some from private commercial codebases, to keep models from having seen them.

zh: 于是 Anthropic 只好重新设计这套笔试，专门写了篇文章讲怎么出「AI 难以代劳」的技术考题。
en: So Anthropic had to redesign that take-home, and wrote up how it builds technical evaluations that AI can't simply ace.

zh: 2025 年 6 月 Karpathy 力挺「上下文工程」：真正的功夫，是往上下文窗口里刚好装进下一步需要的信息。
en: In June 2025 Karpathy backed "context engineering": the art of filling the context window with just the right info for the next step.

zh: Claude 看图按 28×28 像素一小块算一个 token。一张 1000×1000 的图大约是 1296 个 token。
en: Claude sees images in 28×28-pixel patches, one token each. A 1000×1000 image costs about 1,296 tokens.

zh: 工具返回结果时，用人能读懂的名字代替一长串 UUID，智能体更不容易认错、编错。
en: Have tools return human-readable names instead of cryptic UUIDs. Agents make fewer mistakes and hallucinate less.

zh: Codex 论文发现：提示里的代码如果有隐蔽 bug，模型会倾向于写出同样有问题的代码，越大越会模仿。
en: The Codex paper found that when the prompt's code has subtle bugs, the model tends to write buggier code too.

zh: Anthropic 2025 年 4 月的统计：创业公司占 Claude Code 对话的 33%，企业相关工作约占 24%。
en: Anthropic's April 2025 data: startup work made up 33% of Claude Code conversations, enterprise work about 24%.

zh: WebDev Arena 让两个模型各写一个网页应用，用户上手试完投票选更好的，再按投票算排名。
en: WebDev Arena has two models each build a web app; users try both, vote for the better one, and votes become a ranking.

zh: Anthropic 让 16 个 Claude 并行协作，从零用 Rust 写了个 C 编译器，能编译 Linux 内核。
en: Anthropic had 16 Claude instances work in parallel to write a C compiler from scratch in Rust that can compile the Linux kernel.

zh: 2025 年 5 月 OpenAI 发布云端编程智能体，名字又用回了 2021 年那个「Codex」。
