en: In May 2025 OpenAI launched a cloud coding agent and reused a 2021 name for it: Codex.

zh: Claude 的新模型用「自适应思考」：模型自己判断要想多久，你用 effort 参数调它更省还是更认真。
en: Newer Claude models use adaptive thinking: the model decides how much to think, and the effort setting steers that.

zh: 从最简单的方案开始。Anthropic 的建议是：一次调用加检索和示例够用，就别急着上智能体。
en: Start simple. Anthropic advises that if one LLM call with retrieval and examples does the job, don't reach for an agent.

zh: 2023 年研究发现，上下文里只要混进一点「潜在 bug」，代码模型的补全通过率就会大幅下滑。
en: A 2023 study found that seeding the context with potential bugs made code models' completion pass rates drop sharply.

zh: Jason Wei 提出「验证者定律」：一件事越容易验证对错，AI 就越快学会它。编程正好是容易验证的。
en: Jason Wei's "verifier's law": the easier a task is to verify, the sooner AI will master it. Code is easy to check.

zh: OpenAI 的 MLE-bench 用 75 个 Kaggle 比赛来考 AI 做机器学习工程的能力。
en: OpenAI's MLE-bench tests AI on machine learning engineering using 75 Kaggle competitions.

zh: 2026 年 4 月 Anthropic 发布 Claude Mythos Preview，SWE-bench Verified 达 93.9%，却决定不公开发布，只给少数伙伴做防御性安全。
en: In Apr 2026 Anthropic unveiled Claude Mythos Preview at 93.9% on SWE-bench Verified, but withheld it, sharing it only for cyber defense.

zh: 2025 年 6 月谷歌开源 Gemini CLI，个人用谷歌账号登录，每天能免费调用 1000 次。
en: In June 2025 Google open-sourced Gemini CLI, free with a personal Google account for up to 1,000 requests a day.

zh: Anthropic 的上下文管理三板斧：压缩（把旧对话总结掉）、结构化笔记（写到窗口外）、子智能体（分头干活交摘要）。
en: Anthropic's long-task context tools: compaction (summarize old turns), structured notes (saved outside the window) and sub-agents.

zh: 长任务的交接秘诀：让智能体维护进度文件和 git 提交记录，下一个新会话读完就能接着干。
en: For long tasks, have the agent keep a progress file and git commits, so a fresh session can read them and pick up the work.

zh: 2025 年安全研究人员演示过：在 AI 编程工具的规则文件里藏看不见的 Unicode 字符，能让 AI 悄悄往代码里塞恶意脚本。
en: In 2025 researchers showed invisible Unicode hidden in AI coding rules files can make the AI quietly slip malicious code in.

zh: Addy Osmani 的「70% 问题」：AI 能很快帮你做出 70%，剩下 30% 的边界情况和打磨才是真功夫。
en: Addy Osmani's "70% problem": AI gets you 70% of the way fast; the last 30%, edge cases and polish, is the hard part.

zh: METR 的 RE-Bench 发现：给 2 小时，AI 智能体比人类专家做得好；给到 8 小时以上，人类反超。
en: METR's RE-Bench found AI agents beat human experts with a 2-hour budget, but humans pulled ahead at 8+ hours.

zh: 从 Claude Opus 4.7 开始换了新分词器，同样的文字会多切出一些 token。
en: Starting with Claude Opus 4.7, Anthropic switched to a new tokenizer that splits the same text into more tokens.

zh: 早期 AI 补全工具 Kite 2022 年宣布告别，创始人复盘说：我们早了十多年，技术还没准备好。
en: Kite, an early AI code-completion startup, said farewell in 2022. Its founder said they were 10+ years too early: the tech wasn't ready.

zh: 「即时上下文」：不把所有文件预先塞进去，只留文件路径这类线索，需要时让智能体自己去读。
en: "Just in time" context: instead of preloading files, keep lightweight references like paths and let the agent load them when needed.

zh: Anthropic 让智能体用 JSON 记功能清单而不是 Markdown，因为模型更少乱改 JSON 文件。
en: Anthropic kept the agent's feature list in JSON, not Markdown, because models are less likely to inappropriately edit JSON.

zh: Invariant Labs 演示过：在公开仓库发一个恶意 issue，读到它的智能体就可能把私有仓库的数据泄露出去。
en: Invariant Labs showed a malicious issue in a public repo could trick an agent reading it into leaking private repo data.

zh: OpenAI 的 PaperBench 让 AI 从零复现 20 篇 ICML 2024 论文，发布时最好的模型得分 21%。
en: OpenAI's PaperBench asks AI to replicate 20 ICML 2024 papers from scratch. At launch the best model scored 21%.

zh: 从 4.6 这一代开始，Claude 的模型 ID 不再带日期，比如 claude-opus-5-5，但每个 ID 仍固定指向同一个快照。
en: From the 4.6 generation on, Claude model IDs dropped the date, like claude-opus-5-5, yet each still pins one snapshot.

zh: 2023 年 DeepMind 的 AlphaDev 找到更快的短序列排序程序，并入了 LLVM 的 C++ 标准库，那块代码十多年没动过。
en: In 2023 DeepMind's AlphaDev found faster short-sequence sorting routines, merged into LLVM's libc++, code untouched for over a decade.

zh: 子智能体可以翻几万 token 的资料，但只交回一两千 token 的精华摘要，主智能体的上下文就保持干净。
en: A sub-agent may explore tens of thousands of tokens but return a condensed 1,000-2,000 token summary, keeping the lead agent clean.

zh: Aider 发现，让模型用 unified diff 格式改代码，GPT-4 Turbo 偷懒留「此处省略」的情况少了约三分之二。
en: Aider found that having GPT-4 Turbo edit via unified diffs made it about 3x less lazy about leaving placeholder comments.

zh: 2025 年 8 月一起 npm 供应链攻击里，恶意代码会调用电脑上装好的 AI 命令行工具，让 AI 帮它翻找敏感数据。
en: In an Aug 2025 npm supply chain attack, malware tried to use locally installed AI CLIs to help it hunt for sensitive data.

zh: BigCodeBench 收了 1140 道题，要求调用 139 个真实库，考的是「会不会用库」而不只是写算法。
en: BigCodeBench has 1,140 tasks calling 139 real libraries, testing whether models can use libraries, not just write algorithms.

zh: 2026 年 9 月发布的 Claude Opus 5.5，官方称多数任务达到 Fable 5.1 的水平，运行成本比 Opus 5 低 40%。
en: Claude Opus 5.5 (Sept 2026) matches Claude Fable 5.1 on most work, Anthropic says, and costs 40% less to run than Opus 5.

zh: 2025 年 DeepMind 的 AlphaEvolve 找到只用 48 次乘法算 4×4 复数矩阵乘法的方法，改进了 1969 年的 Strassen 算法。
en: In 2025 DeepMind's AlphaEvolve found a way to multiply 4×4 complex matrices with 48 multiplications, improving on Strassen's 1969 method.

zh: 「上下文腐烂」：Chroma 测了 18 个模型，输入越长，表现越差，哪怕是很简单的任务。
en: "Context rot": Chroma tested 18 models and found performance drops as input gets longer, even on simple tasks.

zh: Airbnb 用大模型把近 3500 个 React 测试文件从 Enzyme 迁到 RTL，6 周干完，原本估计要一年半。
en: Airbnb used LLMs to migrate nearly 3,500 React test files from Enzyme to RTL in 6 weeks, a job estimated at 1.5 years.

zh: Advent of Code 的 FAQ 直说别用 AI 解题；办到第 10 年后，作者干脆取消了全球排行榜。
en: Advent of Code's FAQ says don't use AI to solve the puzzles, and after ten years its creator removed the global leaderboard.

zh: CRUXEval 反过来考模型：给一段代码和输入，让它预测输出，看它是不是真的「读懂」了代码。
en: CRUXEval flips the task: given code and an input, predict the output, to test whether a model really understands code.

zh: 截至 2026 年 10 月，Claude Fable 5.1、Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5 的上下文都是 100 万 token，单次最多输出 12.8 万 token。
en: As of Oct 2026, Claude Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 all have 1M-token context and can output up to 128K tokens at once.

zh: AlphaEvolve 给谷歌数据中心找到一条调度规则，上线后持续收回了全球约 0.7% 的算力。
en: A scheduling heuristic AlphaEvolve found for Google's data centers continuously recovers about 0.7% of Google's worldwide compute.

zh: 「迷失在中间」：2023 年研究发现，关键信息放在长上下文的开头或结尾，模型用得最好；放中间最容易被忽略。
en: "Lost in the middle" (2023): models use information best at the start or end of a long context and worst in the middle.

zh: Airbnb 的诀窍之一：失败了就把报错喂回去重试，像刷关一样一步步推着每个文件过关。
en: One Airbnb trick: on failure, feed the errors back and retry, pushing each file through validation step by step.

zh: curl 维护者 Daniel Stenberg 多次吐槽 AI 生成的假漏洞报告太耗人力，curl 漏洞赏金于 2026 年 1 月底停止。
en: curl's Daniel Stenberg repeatedly flagged AI-generated bogus bug reports; curl's bug bounty ended at the end of January 2026.

zh: SWE-bench Lite 从原版 2294 道题里挑出 300 道更独立的 bug 修复题，跑一遍更快更便宜。
en: SWE-bench Lite is a 300-task subset of SWE-bench's 2,294, picked to be more self-contained, making runs cheaper and faster.

zh: 「宪法 AI」是 Anthropic 2022 年提出的训练方法：给模型一套写明的原则，让它按原则批评和修改自己的回答。
en: Constitutional AI, introduced by Anthropic in 2022, trains a model to critique and revise its own answers against written principles.

zh: 2025 年 ICPC 全球总决赛，Gemini 2.5 Deep Think 做对 12 题里的 10 题，其中一题所有人类队伍都没做出来。
en: At the 2025 ICPC World Finals, Gemini 2.5 Deep Think solved 10 of 12 problems, including one that no human team solved.

zh: 「大海捞针」测试：在很长的文本里藏一句无关的话，看模型能不能找出来。Greg Kamradt 2023 年让它流行起来。
en: The "needle in a haystack" test hides one odd sentence in a long text and asks the model to find it. Greg Kamradt popularized it in 2023.

zh: 谷歌内部用大模型做代码迁移，落地的修改里 80% 是 AI 写的，总耗时估计省了一半。
en: In Google's internal code migrations with LLMs, 80% of landed changes were AI-authored, and total time was cut by an estimated 50%.

zh: 2023 年公布的 Claude 宪法，原则来源五花八门，包括联合国《世界人权宣言》，甚至还有苹果的服务条款。
en: Claude's 2023 constitution drew on varied sources, including the UN Declaration of Human Rights and even Apple's terms of service.

zh: 2025 年 7 月 AtCoder 世界巡回赛启发式决赛，10 小时比拼里人类选手 Psyho 赢了 OpenAI 的模型，AI 拿第二。
en: At AtCoder's 2025 World Tour Finals (Heuristic), human coder Psyho beat OpenAI's model over 10 hours; the AI placed second.

zh: 自洽性方法：同一题让模型用不同思路做很多遍，再投票选最多的答案，往往比只做一遍准。
en: Self-consistency: sample many different reasoning paths for one question and take the majority answer. It usually beats a single try.

zh: 亚马逊用 AI 助手升级 Java 应用，单个应用从约 50 人天缩到几小时，Andy Jassy 说相当于省下 4500 个开发者年。
en: Amazon's AI assistant cut Java upgrades from ~50 developer-days to a few hours per app. Andy Jassy estimated 4,500 developer-years saved.

zh: 2024 年 5 月 Anthropic 调高了 Claude 内部的「金门大桥」特征，那一版 Claude 三句不离大桥，问它长啥样，它说自己像金门大桥。
en: In May 2024 Anthropic dialed up a Golden Gate Bridge feature in Claude. It brought up the bridge nonstop, even saying it looked like one.

zh: OpenAI 在 2025 年的论文里报告，o3 的 Codeforces 等级分达到 2724，超过 99.8% 的人类选手。
en: In a 2025 paper OpenAI reported that o3 reached a Codeforces rating of 2724, above 99.8% of human competitors.

zh: Reflexion 让智能体失败后用文字反思「哪里错了」并记下来，下一轮再试，在 HumanEval 上做到 91% 一次通过。
en: Reflexion has an agent write a verbal reflection after failing and retry with it in memory. It hit 91% pass@1 on HumanEval.

zh: 新一代 Claude 能同时发起多个工具调用，比如一次读好几个文件。在提示里鼓励一句，效率高不少。
en: Newer Claude models can make several tool calls at once, like reading multiple files. A nudge in the prompt boosts this.

zh: 2025 年 8 月 Claude Sonnet 4 在 API 上支持 100 万 token 上下文，足够一次读进 7.5 万行以上的代码库。
en: In Aug 2025 Claude Sonnet 4 got a 1M-token context on the API, enough for codebases of over 75,000 lines in one request.

zh: 2023 年 6 月 OpenAI 在 API 里推出函数调用：模型输出一段结构化 JSON，请你的程序去调某个函数。
en: In June 2023 OpenAI added function calling to its API: the model outputs structured JSON asking your code to call a function.

zh: 「致命三要素」：智能体同时能读私密数据、会接触不可信内容、又能往外发消息，就可能被诱导泄密。
en: The "lethal trifecta": an agent with private data, exposure to untrusted content and a way to send data out can be tricked into leaking.

zh: 模型最容易编错冷门 API。亚马逊的研究里，把相关文档放进上下文，GPT-4o 调冷门 API 的正确率从 38.6% 升到 47.9%。
en: Models flub rarely used APIs. In an Amazon study, adding docs to context lifted GPT-4o's valid calls to them from 38.6% to 47.9%.

zh: 2026 年 2 月 5 日发布的 Claude Opus 4.6，是第一个支持 100 万 token 上下文的 Opus 级模型（测试版）。
en: Claude Opus 4.6, released Feb 5, 2026, was the first Opus-class model with a 1M-token context window, in beta.

zh: 2022 年的 ReAct 论文让模型「想一步、做一步、看结果」交替进行，这就是今天智能体循环的雏形。
en: The 2022 ReAct paper had models interleave reasoning and actions, then observe results: the seed of today's agent loop.

zh: LLMflation：a16z 测算，达到同等能力的大模型推理成本，大约每年降到原来的十分之一。
en: "LLMflation": a16z estimated the cost of LLM inference at a fixed capability level falls about 10x every year.

zh: 中途发现方向不对就早点打断纠正，比等它写完一大坨再返工划算得多。
en: Course-correct early. Interrupting when the AI heads the wrong way beats reworking a big finished change.

zh: 2023 年 Meta 的 Toolformer 让模型自学什么时候该调计算器、搜索这类工具，只需要每种工具几个示范。
en: Meta's 2023 Toolformer taught a model to decide on its own when to call tools like a calculator or search, from a handful of demos per tool.

zh: Anthropic 给 Claude 加了个「think」工具，让它在工具调用间停下来想想。配上优化过的提示词，τ-bench 航空场景相对提升 54%。
en: Anthropic gave Claude a "think" tool to pause between tool calls. With an optimized prompt, it scored 54% higher on τ-bench airline.

zh: 给 AI 的指令越具体，第一次就做对的概率越高。「给 foo.py 加测试」不如「给 foo.py 写一个覆盖用户登出边界情况的测试，别用 mock」。
en: Specific instructions win. "Add tests for foo.py" < "test the logged-out edge case in foo.py, avoid mocks."

zh: 微软 2016 年推出语言服务器协议 LSP，把「M 个编辑器 × N 种语言」的适配变成 M + N。MCP 借鉴了这个思路。
en: Microsoft's 2016 Language Server Protocol turned M editors × N languages into M + N integrations. MCP borrowed the idea.

zh: 让智能体写代码去调工具，而不是一个个直接调，Anthropic 的例子里 token 从 15 万降到 2000，省了 98.7%。
en: Having agents write code to call tools instead of calling them directly cut one Anthropic example from 150,000 tokens to 2,000.

zh: Kent Beck 把 AI 编程智能体比作「难以捉摸的精灵」：会实现你的愿望，但常常是用意想不到的方式。
en: Kent Beck calls AI coding agents an unpredictable genie: it grants your wishes, but often in unexpected ways.

zh: 2026 年 6 月 Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5，官方说它是一个做到能安全公开使用的 Mythos 级模型。
en: In June 2026 Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5, which it called a Mythos-class model made safe for general use.

zh: 2025 年 3 月 Sam Altman 发推说，OpenAI 要在自家产品里全面支持 MCP。Anthropic 提出的协议，OpenAI 也用上了。
en: In March 2025 Sam Altman said OpenAI would add MCP support across its products, adopting a protocol that came from Anthropic.

zh: Anthropic 的多智能体研究系统，比单个智能体效果好 90.2%，代价是用掉约 15 倍于普通聊天的 token。
en: Anthropic's multi-agent research system beat a single agent by 90.2%, but used about 15x the tokens of a normal chat.

zh: 伯克利的 Gorilla 发现，让模型调 API 前先检索最新文档，能明显减少编造不存在的 API 调用。
en: Berkeley's Gorilla showed that retrieving up-to-date API docs before generating calls sharply cuts hallucinated API usage.

zh: 早期测试时，Stripe 反馈说 Claude Fable 5 把好几个月的工程量压缩到了几天。
en: In early testing, Stripe reported that Claude Fable 5 compressed months of engineering work into days.

zh: 2025 年 12 月 Anthropic 把 MCP 捐给 Linux 基金会旗下新成立的 Agentic AI 基金会，不再由一家公司掌管。
en: In December 2025 Anthropic donated MCP to the new Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation, so no single company controls it.

zh: Anthropic 发现，单看 token 用量，就能解释多智能体系统在 BrowseComp 上 80% 的成绩差异。
en: Analyzing its multi-agent research system, Anthropic found token usage alone explained 80% of the variance on BrowseComp.

zh: 工具不是越多越好。Anthropic 建议少做几个精心设计、贴合真实任务的工具，别把每个 API 都包一层。
en: More tools isn't better. Anthropic advises a few thoughtful tools for real workflows rather than wrapping every API endpoint.

zh: 2026 年 7 月的 Claude Opus 5，官方说它的智能接近 Fable 5，价格只要一半。
en: Claude Opus 5 (July 2026) comes close to the frontier intelligence of Claude Fable 5 at half the price, Anthropic says.

zh: AGENTS.md 被叫作「给智能体看的 README」：在仓库根目录写清怎么构建、怎么测试、守哪些规矩。
en: AGENTS.md is a "README for agents": a file at the repo root telling coding agents how to build, test and follow project conventions.

zh: 多智能体并不总是划算。Anthropic 认为，大多数编程任务里能真正并行的部分比研究任务少。
en: Multi-agent isn't always worth it. Anthropic notes most coding tasks have fewer truly parallelizable parts than research does.

zh: 2026 年 9 月 1 日发布的 Claude Fable 5.1，输入输出价格和 Fable 5 一样，缓存读取只要原来的四分之一。
en: Claude Fable 5.1 (Sept 1, 2026) kept Fable 5's input and output prices but cut cache reads to a quarter of the cost.

zh: llms.txt 是 Jeremy Howard 2024 年提出的约定：在网站根目录放一份写给大模型读的 Markdown 简介。
en: llms.txt, proposed by Jeremy Howard in 2024, is a convention: a Markdown file at a website's root written for LLMs to read.

zh: Embedding 把一段文字变成一串数字，意思相近的文字在空间里离得近。RAG 就靠它找相关资料。
en: An embedding turns text into a vector of numbers so similar meanings sit close together. RAG uses this to find relevant material.

zh: 2026 年 9 月底发布的 Claude Sonnet 5.5，每百万 token 输入 2 美元、输出 10 美元。
en: Claude Sonnet 5.5, released in late Sept 2026, costs $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens.

zh: 「提示注入」这个词是 Simon Willison 2022 年 9 月起的，借用了「SQL 注入」的说法。
en: Simon Willison coined "prompt injection" in September 2022, borrowing from the name of SQL injection.

zh: Anthropic 自己不提供 embedding 模型，官方文档推荐用 Voyage AI 的。
en: Anthropic doesn't offer its own embedding model; its docs point developers to Voyage AI.

zh: Claude Opus 4.5 在中等 effort 下就追平了 Sonnet 4.5 的 SWE-bench 最好成绩，输出 token 却少用 76%。
en: At medium effort, Claude Opus 4.5 matched Sonnet 4.5's best SWE-bench Verified score using 76% fewer output tokens.

zh: 「RAG」这个词出自 2020 年 Facebook AI 等机构的论文：先检索资料，再让模型生成答案。
en: "RAG" comes from a 2020 paper by Facebook AI and collaborators: retrieve relevant documents first, then let the model generate.

zh: 2024 年 10 月 Anthropic 推出消息批处理 API，一批最多 1 万条请求，价格打五折。
en: In Oct 2024 Anthropic launched the Message Batches API: up to 10,000 queries per batch at half the price.

zh: RAG 论文一作 Patrick Lewis 后来说，要是早知道这个方法会这么火，当初就会好好起个名字。
en: RAG lead author Patrick Lewis later said that had they known it would be so widespread, they'd have put more thought into the name.

zh: Claude Sonnet 4.5 带「上下文感知」：每调一次工具，API 就告诉它还剩多少 token，长任务更好安排节奏。
en: Claude Sonnet 4.5 has context awareness: after each tool call it is told how many tokens remain, so it paces long tasks better.

zh: 2022 年谷歌的思维链论文发现：在示例里写出推理步骤，大模型做数学和逻辑题就准得多。
en: Google's 2022 chain-of-thought paper found that showing reasoning steps in the examples made large models far better at math and logic.

zh: 2022 年一篇论文发现，只要在问题后加一句「让我们一步步想」，模型在 MultiArith 上的准确率从 17.7% 升到 78.7%。
en: A 2022 paper found that adding "Let's think step by step" lifted accuracy on MultiArith from 17.7% to 78.7%.

zh: 2024 年 9 月 OpenAI 发布 o1：先在内部想一长段再作答，想得越久，结果往往越好。推理模型从这里走红。
en: OpenAI's o1 (Sept 2024) thinks at length before answering, and does better the longer it thinks. Reasoning models took off from there.

zh: Karpathy 2025 年 6 月在 YC 的 AI 创业学校演讲里讲「Software 3.0」：提示词就是程序，用英语来写。
en: In a 2025 talk at YC, Karpathy described "Software 3.0": prompts are programs, and they're written in English.

zh: 2023 年 7 月 Code Interpreter 向所有 ChatGPT Plus 用户开放，模型能在对话里写 Python 并当场运行。
en: In July 2023 Code Interpreter rolled out to all ChatGPT Plus users, letting the model write and actually run Python in chat.

zh: 2023 年 12 月 DeepMind 发布 AlphaCode 2，在 Codeforces 比赛中估计超过了 85% 的参赛者。
en: DeepMind's AlphaCode 2 (Dec 2023) was estimated to outperform 85% of competitors in Codeforces contests.

zh: DeepSeek-Coder 的训练数据有 2 万亿 token，其中 87% 是代码，13% 是中英文自然语言。
en: DeepSeek-Coder was trained on 2 trillion tokens: 87% code and 13% natural language in English and Chinese.

zh: GitHub 2023 年 2 月说，Copilot 平均写了开发者 46% 的代码，Java 里高达 61%。
en: GitHub said in Feb 2023 that Copilot was behind an average of 46% of developers' code, and 61% in Java.

zh: GitHub 2024 年度报告：Python 超过 JavaScript，成为 GitHub 上最常用的语言，结束了 JS 十年霸榜。
en: GitHub's Octoverse 2024: Python overtook JavaScript as the most used language on GitHub, ending JS's 10-year run at the top.

zh: Simon Willison 从 2024 年起用「SVG 画鹈鹕骑自行车」测新模型。头一年画得好坏跟模型强弱挺对得上，现在他说基本不准了。
en: Simon Willison tests models with an SVG pelican on a bicycle. Early on it tracked model quality; now he says it mostly doesn't.

zh: 2025 年 9 月 Anthropic 发文说，打造智能体的核心正从「写好提示词」转向「管好上下文」。
en: In Sept 2025 Anthropic wrote that building agents is shifting from prompt engineering to context engineering.
